// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

async function chart_facetTemplate(container, options = {}, __facetRows, __facetColorDomain) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = __facetRows;
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["yield"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yield"]));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_yield": d3.sum(rows, d => d["yield"])}), d => d["site"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"site": k1, ...vals}));

  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(__facetColorDomain, d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  {
    const plotRadius = Math.min((width - marginLeft - marginRight), (height - marginTop - marginBottom)) / 2;
    const pie = d3.pie().value(d => d["sum_yield"]).sort(null);
    const arcGen = d3.arc().innerRadius(0).outerRadius(plotRadius);
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${width / 2},${height / 2})`)
      .selectAll("path")
      .data(pie(data1))
      .join("path")
        .attr("d", arcGen)
        .attr("fill", d => color(d.data["site"]));
  }

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  // vl2d3: unsupported top-level composition "facet", splitting the shared data by facet value at runtime instead of code-generation time -- each panel shows a plain text header (the raw/timeUnit'd facet value), not Vega-Lite's own fully templated header (--ignore-unsupported)
  let facetData = await d3.json(new URL("data/barley.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  const __facetColorDomain = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(facetData.map(d => d["site"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b));
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "__facetKey": d["year"]}));
  const __facetGroups = Array.from(d3.group(facetData, d => d["__facetKey"]), ([key, rows]) => ({key, rows}));
  __facetGroups.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.key, b.key));
  const doc = container.ownerDocument;
  const wrap = doc.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 4px;";
  container.appendChild(wrap);
  for (const {key, rows} of __facetGroups) {
    const panelWrap = doc.createElement("div");
    wrap.appendChild(panelWrap);
    const label = doc.createElement("div");
    label.style.cssText = "font-size: 11px; font-family: sans-serif;";
    label.textContent = String(key);
    panelWrap.appendChild(label);
    const panel = doc.createElement("div");
    panelWrap.appendChild(panel);
    await chart_facetTemplate(panel, options, rows, __facetColorDomain);
  }
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 300;
  const height = options.height ?? 200;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/unemployment-across-industries.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_count": d3.sum(rows, d => d["count"])}), d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"yearmonth_date": k1, ...vals}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["yearmonth_date"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["sum_count"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["sum_count"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "sum_count_stack0": y0, "sum_count_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => +d["yearmonth_date"]))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_count_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_count_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("count");

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "steelblue")
      .attr("d", d3.area().defined(d => d["yearmonth_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yearmonth_date"]) && d["sum_count_stack1"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["sum_count_stack1"]) && d["sum_count_stack0"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["sum_count_stack0"])).x(d => x(d["yearmonth_date"])).y0(d => y(d["sum_count_stack0"])).y1(d => y(d["sum_count_stack1"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["yearmonth_date"], b["yearmonth_date"]))));

  return svg.node();

async function chart_facetTemplate(container, options = {}, __facetRows, __facetXDomain, __facetYDomain) {
  const width = options.width ?? 400;
  const height = options.height ?? 80;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

        const __v = +d["density"];

      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "density_stack0": y0, "density_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const y = d3.scaleLinear(__facetYDomain, [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]);

      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  // vl2d3: unsupported top-level composition "facet", splitting the shared data by facet value at runtime instead of code-generation time -- each panel shows a plain text header (the raw/timeUnit'd facet value), not Vega-Lite's own fully templated header (--ignore-unsupported)
  let facetData = await d3.json(new URL("data/penguins.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  facetData = Array.from(d3.rollup(facetData, rows => {
    const values = rows.map(d => d["Body Mass (g)"]).filter(v => v != null && !Number.isNaN(v));
    const bandwidth = (() => {
      const n = values.length;
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const std = Math.sqrt(d3.sum(values, v => (v - mean) ** 2) / Math.max(n - 1, 1));
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const iqr = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75) - d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25);
      const sigma = Math.min(std, iqr / 1.34) || std || 1;
      return (0.9 * sigma * Math.pow(n, -0.2)) || 1;
    })();
    const [lo, hi] = [2500, 6500];
    const kernel = x => Math.exp(-0.5 * (x / bandwidth) ** 2) / (bandwidth * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
    return d3.range(200).map(i => {
      const v = lo + (i * (hi - lo)) / (200 - 1);
      return {"value": v, "density": d3.mean(values, x => kernel(v - x))};
    });
  }, d => JSON.stringify([d["Species"]])), ([key, points]) => { const keyVals = JSON.parse(key); return points.map(p => ({...p, "Species": keyVals[0]})); }).flat();
  const __facetXDomain = d3.extent(facetData, d => d["value"]);
  const __facetYDomain = [Math.min(0, d3.min(facetData, d => d["density"])), Math.max(0, d3.max(facetData, d => d["density"]))];
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "__facetKey": d["Species"]}));
  const __facetGroups = Array.from(d3.group(facetData, d => d["__facetKey"]), ([key, rows]) => ({key, rows}));
  __facetGroups.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.key, b.key));
  const doc = container.ownerDocument;
  const wrap = doc.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;";
  container.appendChild(wrap);
  for (const {key, rows} of __facetGroups) {
    const panelWrap = doc.createElement("div");
    wrap.appendChild(panelWrap);
    const label = doc.createElement("div");
    label.style.cssText = "font-size: 11px; font-family: sans-serif;";
    label.textContent = String(key);
    panelWrap.appendChild(label);
    const panel = doc.createElement("div");
    panelWrap.appendChild(panel);
    await chart_facetTemplate(panel, {...options, width: 400, height: 80}, rows, __facetXDomain, __facetYDomain);
  }
}

      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Body Mass (g)");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("density");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.7)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["Species"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("fill", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.area().defined(d => d["value"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["value"]) && d["density_stack1"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["density_stack1"]) && d["density_stack0"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["density_stack0"])).x(d => x(d["value"])).y0(d => y(d["density_stack0"])).y1(d => y(d["density_stack1"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["value"], b["value"]))));

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 400;
  const height = options.height ?? 100;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.flatMap(d => ["Displacement","Horsepower"].map(f => ({...d, "Measurement": f, "value": d[f]})));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => {
    const values = rows.map(d => d["value"]).filter(v => v != null && !Number.isNaN(v));
    const bandwidth = 10;
    const [lo, hi] = [10, 500];
    const kernel = x => Math.exp(-0.5 * (x / bandwidth) ** 2) / (bandwidth * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
    return d3.range(200).map(i => {
      const v = lo + (i * (hi - lo)) / (200 - 1);
      return {"value": v, "density": d3.mean(values, x => kernel(v - x)) * values.length};
    });
  }, d => JSON.stringify([d["Measurement"]])), ([key, points]) => { const keyVals = JSON.parse(key); return points.map(p => ({...p, "Measurement": keyVals[0]})); }).flat();
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["value"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Measurement"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["value"], d["Measurement"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"value": __c, "Measurement": __g, "density": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["value"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["Measurement"], b["Measurement"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["density"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["density"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "density_stack0": y0, "density_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["value"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["density_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["density_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Measurement"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("value");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("density");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.7)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["Measurement"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("fill", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.area().defined(d => d["value"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["value"]) && d["density_stack1"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["density_stack1"]) && d["density_stack0"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["density_stack0"])).x(d => x(d["value"])).y0(d => y(d["density_stack0"])).y1(d => y(d["density_stack1"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["value"], b["value"]))));

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));

      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0": y0, "sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => +d["year_Year"]))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Weight_in_lbs");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Year");

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "steelblue")
      .attr("d", d3.area().defined(d => d["year_Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["year_Year"]) && d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1"]) && d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0"])).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX).y(d => y(d["year_Year"])).x0(d => x(d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0"])).x1(d => x(d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year_Year"], b["year_Year"]))));

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.year == 2000);
  data1 = [(rows => ({"sum_people": d3.sum(rows, d => d["people"])}))(data1)];

  const x = d3.scaleLinear([Math.min(0, d3.min(data1, d => d["sum_people"])), Math.max(0, d3.max(data1, d => d["sum_people"]))], [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("population");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(0), x(d["sum_people"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(0) - x(d["sum_people"])))
      .attr("y", marginTop)
      .attr("height", Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom) - marginTop);

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 300;
  const height = options.height ?? 50;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 15;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 20;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/flights-5k.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["delay"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["delay"]));
  data1 = d3.bin().value(d => d["delay"]).thresholds(100)(data1).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_delay": bin.x0, "bin_delay_end": bin.x1})));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["bin_delay"]), data1.map(d => d["bin_delay_end"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("delay");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d["bin_delay"]), x(d["bin_delay_end"])) + 0.5)
      .attr("width", d => Math.max(0, Math.abs(x(d["bin_delay_end"]) - x(d["bin_delay"])) - 1))
      .attr("y", marginTop)
      .attr("height", Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom) - marginTop);

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Year"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Year"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Year");

  {
    const barWidth = (() => {
      const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => x(d["Year"])))).sort((a, b) => a - b);
      return xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) * 0.7 : 20;
    })();
    svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill", "steelblue")
      .selectAll("rect")
      .data(data1)
      .join("rect")
        .attr("x", d => x(d["Year"]) - barWidth / 2)
        .attr("width", barWidth)
        .attr("y", marginTop)
        .attr("height", Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom) - marginTop)
  }

  return svg.node();
}


===== bar_aggregate_format.vl.json [EXEC] =====
404 Not Found
// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.year == 2000);
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_people": d3.sum(rows, d => d["people"])}), d => d["age"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"age": k1, ...vals}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["age"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["sum_people"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["sum_people"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "sum_people_stack0": y0, "sum_people_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_people_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_people_stack1"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["age"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("population");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("age");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d["sum_people_stack1"]), x(d["sum_people_stack0"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d["sum_people_stack0"]) - x(d["sum_people_stack1"])))
      .attr("y", d => y(d["age"]))
      .attr("height", y.bandwidth());

  return svg.node();
}

      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "sum_people_stack0": y0, "sum_people_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_people_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_people_stack1"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["age"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("population");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("age");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d["sum_people_stack1"]), x(d["sum_people_stack0"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d["sum_people_stack0"]) - x(d["sum_people_stack1"])))
      .attr("y", d => y(d["age"]))
      .attr("height", y.bandwidth());

  return svg.node();
}

      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "mean_acc_stack0": y0, "mean_acc_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => (new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)).getTime() >= (new Date(2005, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)).getTime() && (new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)).getTime() <= (new Date(2005, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)).getTime());
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "binnedyearmonth_date": new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["binnedyearmonth_date"], d["symbol"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["price"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["price"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "price_stack0": y0, "price_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => +d["binnedyearmonth_date"]))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["price_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["price_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["symbol"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["symbol"]))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["price_stack1"]), y(d["price_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["price_stack0"]) - y(d["price_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["binnedyearmonth_date"]) - 2.5)
      .attr("width", 5);

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.symbol==='GOOG');
  data1 = data1.filter(d => (new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)).getTime() >= (new Date(2005, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)).getTime() && (new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)).getTime() <= (new Date(2005, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)).getTime());

      return rows.map(d => {

      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "price_stack0": y0, "price_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  data2 = data2.filter(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"]));

  data2 = data2.map(d => ({...d, "binnedyearmonth_date": new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(([].concat(data1.map(d => d["binnedyearmonth_date"]), data2.map(d => d["binnedyearmonth_date"]))).map(v => +v))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ?       .attr("width", width)

      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)

      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["price_stack1"]), y(d["price_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["price_stack0"]) - y(d["price_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["binnedyearmonth_date"]) - 2.5)
      .attr("width", 5);

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("fill", "black")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(data2)
    .join("text")
      .attr("x", d => x(d["binnedyearmonth_date"]))
      .attr("y", d => y(d["price"]))
      .attr("dy", "0.32em")
      .text(d => d["price"]);

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 400;
  const height = options.height ?? 250;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Year"]) && d["Origin"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Origin"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"count": rows.length}), d => d["Origin"], d => new Date(d["Year"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"Origin": k1, "year_Year": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["year_Year"], d["Origin"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["count"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["count"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "count_stack0": y0, "count_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => +d["year_Year"]))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["count_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["count_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Year");

  svg.append("g")

  svg.append("text")

      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Number of Cars");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["Origin"]))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["count_stack1"]), y(d["count_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["count_stack0"]) - y(d["count_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["year_Year"]) - 2.5)
      .attr("width", 5);

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();

  const height = options.height ?? 400;

  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Acceleration"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Acceleration"]));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_Acceleration": d3.mean(rows, d => d["Acceleration"])}), d => d["Cylinders"], d => d["Origin"]), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"Cylinders": k1, "Origin": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);

      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "mean_Acceleration_stack0": y0, "mean_Acceleration_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();
  let data2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d["Acceleration"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Acceleration"]));

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([].concat(data1.map(d => d["Cylinders"]), data2.map(d => d["Cylinders"])))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["mean_Acceleration_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["mean_Acceleration_stack1"]), data2.map(d => d["Acceleration"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([...data1, ...data2].map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();
  const xOffset = (() => { const __dom = Array.from(new d3.InternSet([...data1, ...data2].map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)); const __outerBW = x.bandwidth(); let __s = d3.scaleBand(__dom, [0, __outerBW]).padding(0.05); if (__s.bandwidth() < 1) __s = d3.scaleBand(__dom, [0, __s.bandwidth() > 0 ? __outerBW * 1 / __s.bandwidth() : 1 * __dom.length]).padding(0.05); return __s; })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));

      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Cylinders");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Acceleration");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["Origin"]))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["mean_Acceleration_stack1"]), y(d["mean_Acceleration_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["mean_Acceleration_stack0"]) - y(d["mean_Acceleration_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["Cylinders"]) + xOffset(d["Origin"]))
      .attr("width", xOffset.bandwidth());

  {

      const values = rows.map(d => d["Acceleration"]).filter(v => v != null);
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const stdev = d3.deviation(values) ?? 0;
      const stderr = stdev / Math.sqrt(values.length);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75);
      return {...rows[0], lower: mean - stderr, upper: mean + stderr};
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(errStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => y(d.lower))
        .attr("y2", d => y(d.upper))
        .attr("x1", d => x(d["Cylinders"]) + xOffset(d["Origin"]) + xOffset.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("x2", d => x(d["Cylinders"]) + xOffset(d["Origin"]) + xOffset.bandwidth() / 2)
  }

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data2)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color("US Gross"))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["sum_US Gross_stack1"]), y(d["sum_US Gross_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["sum_US Gross_stack0"]) - y(d["sum_US Gross_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["Major Genre"]) + xOffset("US Gross"))
      .attr("width", xOffset.bandwidth());

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {

  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Weight_in_lbs"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Weight_in_lbs"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_Weight_in_lbs": d3.sum(rows, d => d["Weight_in_lbs"])}), d => d["Cylinders"], d => d["Origin"], d => new Date(d["Year"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, __inner1]) => Array.from(__inner1, ([k3, vals]) => ({"Cylinders": k1, "Origin": k2, "year_Year": k3, ...vals})))).flat(2);
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Cylinders"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["year_Year"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["Cylinders"], d["year_Year"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"Cylinders": __c, "year_Year": __g, "sum_Weight_in_lbs": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["Cylinders"], d["Origin"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year_Year"], b["year_Year"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["sum_Weight_in_lbs"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["sum_Weight_in_lbs"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0": y0, "sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Cylinders"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const xOffset = (() => { const __dom = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)); const __outerBW = x.bandwidth(); let __s = d3.scaleBand(__dom, [0, __outerBW]).padding(0.05); if (__s.bandwidth() < 1) __s = d3.scaleBand(__dom, [0, __s.bandwidth() > 0 ? __outerBW * 1 / __s.bandwidth() : 1 * __dom.length]).padding(0.05); return __s; })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));

      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("id");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("record__low");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "#ccc")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["record__low"]), y(d["record__high"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["record__high"]) - y(d["record__low"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["id"]) + (x.bandwidth() - 20) / 2)
      .attr("width", 20);

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "#999")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data2)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["normal__low"]), y(d["normal__high"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["normal__high"]) - y(d["normal__low"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["id"]) + (x.bandwidth() - 20) / 2)
      .attr("width", 20);

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "#000")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data3)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["actual__low"]), y(d["actual__high"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["actual__high"]) - y(d["actual__low"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["id"]) + (x.bandwidth() - 12) / 2)
      .attr("width", 12);

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "#000")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data4)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["forecast__low__low"]), y(d["forecast__low__high"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["forecast__low__high"]) - y(d["forecast__low__low"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["id"]) + (x.bandwidth() - 12) / 2)
      .attr("width", 12);

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "#000")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data5)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["forecast__low__high"]), y(d["forecast__high__low"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["forecast__high__low"]) - y(d["forecast__low__high"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["id"]) + (x.bandwidth() - 3) / 2)
      .attr("width", 3);

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "#000")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data6)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["forecast__high__low"]), y(d["forecast__high__high"])))

      .attr("width", 12);

      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("fill", "black")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(data7)
    .join("text")

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["precipitation"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["precipitation"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_precipitation": d3.mean(rows, d => d["precipitation"])}), d => new Date(2012, d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"month_date": k1, ...vals}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["month_date"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["mean_precipitation"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["mean_precipitation"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "mean_precipitation_stack0": y0, "mean_precipitation_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["month_date"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["mean_precipitation_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["mean_precipitation_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("precipitation");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["mean_precipitation_stack1"]), y(d["mean_precipitation_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["mean_precipitation_stack0"]) - y(d["mean_precipitation_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["month_date"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth());

  return svg.node();
}

      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "mean_precipitation_stack0": y0, "mean_precipitation_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => +d["month_date"]))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["mean_precipitation_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["mean_precipitation_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("precipitation");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["mean_precipitation_stack1"]), y(d["mean_precipitation_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["mean_precipitation_stack0"]) - y(d["mean_precipitation_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["month_date"]) - 2.5)

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"]) && d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_price": d3.sum(rows, d => d["price"])}), d => d["symbol"], d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"symbol": k1, "year_date": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["symbol"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["year_date"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["symbol"], d["year_date"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"symbol": __c, "year_date": __g, "sum_price": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["symbol"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year_date"], b["year_date"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["sum_price"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["sum_price"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "sum_price_stack0": y0, "sum_price_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["symbol"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_price_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_price_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleSequential(d3.extent(data1, d => d["year_date"]), d3.interpolateBlues); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("symbol");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["year_date"]))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["sum_price_stack1"]), y(d["sum_price_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["sum_price_stack0"]) - y(d["sum_price_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["symbol"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth());

  return svg.node();
}

      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("temp_max");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["mean_temp_max_stack1"]), y(d["mean_temp_max_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["mean_temp_max_stack0"]) - y(d["mean_temp_max_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["yearmonthdate_date"]) - 2.5)
      .attr("width", 5);

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/penguins.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Body Mass (g)"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Body Mass (g)"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Body Mass (g)"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Body Mass (g)");

  {
    const boxStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => 0), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["Body Mass (g)"]).filter(v => v != null).sort(d3.ascending);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(values, 0.25), median = d3.quantile(values, 0.5), q3 = d3.quantile(values, 0.75);
      const iqr = q3 - q1;
      const lowerFence = q1 - 1.5 * iqr, upperFence = q3 + 1.5 * iqr;
      const within = values.filter(v => v >= lowerFence && v <= upperFence);
      return {
        ...rows[0],
        q1, median, q3,
        whiskerLow: within.length ? within[0] : q1,
        whiskerHigh: within.length ? within[within.length - 1] : q3,
        outliers: values.filter(v => v < lowerFence || v > upperFence),
      };
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => height / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => height / 2)
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.whiskerLow))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.whiskerHigh))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
      .selectAll("rect")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("rect")
        .attr("y", d => height / 2 - (14) / 2)
        .attr("height", d => 14)
        .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d.q1), x(d.q3)))
        .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d.q3) - x(d.q1)))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "white")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => height / 2 - (14) / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => height / 2 + (14) / 2)
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.median))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.median))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
        .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("circle")
      .data(boxStats.flatMap(d => d.outliers.map(v => ({...d, "Body Mass (g)": v}))))
      .join("circle")
        .attr("cy", d => height / 2)
        .attr("cx", d => x(d["Body Mass (g)"]))
        .attr("r", 3)
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/penguins.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Body Mass (g)"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Body Mass (g)"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Body Mass (g)"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Species"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Body Mass (g)");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Species");

  {
    const boxStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["Species"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["Body Mass (g)"]).filter(v => v != null).sort(d3.ascending);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(values, 0.25), median = d3.quantile(values, 0.5), q3 = d3.quantile(values, 0.75);
      const iqr = q3 - q1;
      const lowerFence = q1 - 1.5 * iqr, upperFence = q3 + 1.5 * iqr;
      const within = values.filter(v => v >= lowerFence && v <= upperFence);
      return {
        ...rows[0],
        q1, median, q3,
        whiskerLow: within.length ? within[0] : q1,
        whiskerHigh: within.length ? within[within.length - 1] : q3,
        outliers: values.filter(v => v < lowerFence || v > upperFence),
      };
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.whiskerLow))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.whiskerHigh))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
      .selectAll("rect")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("rect")
        .attr("y", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 - (Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("height", d => Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14))
        .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d.q1), x(d.q3)))
        .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d.q3) - x(d.q1)))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "white")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 - (Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 + (Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.median))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.median))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
        .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("circle")
      .data(boxStats.flatMap(d => d.outliers.map(v => ({...d, "Body Mass (g)": v}))))
      .join("circle")
        .attr("cy", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("cx", d => x(d["Body Mass (g)"]))
        .attr("r", 3)
  }

  return svg.node();
}

        .attr("y1", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.whiskerLow))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.whiskerHigh))
    svg.append("g")
      .selectAll("rect")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("rect")
        .attr("fill", d => "teal")
        .attr("y", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 - (Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("height", d => Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14))
        .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d.q1), x(d.q3)))
        .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d.q3) - x(d.q1)))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "white")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 - (Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 + (Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.median))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.median))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
        .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("circle")
      .data(boxStats.flatMap(d => d.outliers.map(v => ({...d, "Body Mass (g)": v}))))
      .join("circle")
        .attr("cy", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("cx", d => x(d["Body Mass (g)"]))
        .attr("r", 3)
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/penguins.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Body Mass (g)"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Body Mass (g)"]));

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Species"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Body Mass (g)"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Species"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Species");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Body Mass (g)");

  {
    const boxStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["Species"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["Body Mass (g)"]).filter(v => v != null).sort(d3.ascending);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(values, 0.25), median = d3.quantile(values, 0.5), q3 = d3.quantile(values, 0.75);
      const iqr = q3 - q1;
      const lowerFence = q1 - 1.5 * iqr, upperFence = q3 + 1.5 * iqr;
      const within = values.filter(v => v >= lowerFence && v <= upperFence);
      return {
        ...rows[0],
        q1, median, q3,
        whiskerLow: within.length ? within[0] : q1,
        whiskerHigh: within.length ? within[within.length - 1] : q3,
        outliers: values.filter(v => v < lowerFence || v > upperFence),
      };
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("x2", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("y1", d => y(d.whiskerLow))
        .attr("y2", d => y(d.whiskerHigh))
    svg.append("g")
      .selectAll("rect")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("rect")
        .attr("fill", d => color(d["Species"]))
        .attr("x", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2 - (Math.min(x.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("width", d => Math.min(x.bandwidth(), 14))
        .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d.q1), y(d.q3)))
        .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d.q3) - y(d.q1)))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "white")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2 - (Math.min(x.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("x2", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2 + (Math.min(x.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("y1", d => y(d.median))
        .attr("y2", d => y(d.median))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
        .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("circle")
      .data(boxStats.flatMap(d => d.outliers.map(v => ({...d, "Body Mass (g)": v}))))
      .join("circle")
        .attr("cx", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("cy", d => y(d["Body Mass (g)"]))
        .attr("r", 3)
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Acceleration"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Acceleration"]));

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Cylinders"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Acceleration"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();
  const xOffset = (() => { const __dom = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)); const __outerBW = x.bandwidth(); let __s = d3.scaleBand(__dom, [0, __outerBW]).padding(0.05); if (__s.bandwidth() < 1) __s = d3.scaleBand(__dom, [0, __s.bandwidth() > 0 ? __outerBW * 1 / __s.bandwidth() : 1 * __dom.length]).padding(0.05); return __s; })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Cylinders");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Acceleration");

  {
    const boxStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["Cylinders"], d["Origin"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["Acceleration"]).filter(v => v != null).sort(d3.ascending);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(values, 0.25), median = d3.quantile(values, 0.5), q3 = d3.quantile(values, 0.75);
      const iqr = q3 - q1;
      const lowerFence = q1 - 1.5 * iqr, upperFence = q3 + 1.5 * iqr;
      const within = values.filter(v => v >= lowerFence && v <= upperFence);
      return {
        ...rows[0],
        q1, median, q3,
        whiskerLow: within.length ? within[0] : q1,
        whiskerHigh: within.length ? within[within.length - 1] : q3,
        outliers: values.filter(v => v < lowerFence || v > upperFence),
      };
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d["Cylinders"]) + xOffset(d["Origin"]) + xOffset.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("x2", d => x(d["Cylinders"]) + xOffset(d["Origin"]) + xOffset.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("y1", d => y(d.whiskerLow))
        .attr("y2", d => y(d.whiskerHigh))
    svg.append("g")
      .selectAll("rect")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("rect")
        .attr("fill", d => color(d["Origin"]))
        .attr("x", d => x(d["Cylinders"]) + xOffset(d["Origin"]) + xOffset.bandwidth() / 2 - (xOffset.bandwidth()) / 2)
        .attr("width", d => xOffset.bandwidth())
        .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d.q1), y(d.q3)))
        .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d.q3) - y(d.q1)))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "white")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d["Cylinders"]) + xOffset(d["Origin"]) + xOffset.bandwidth() / 2 - (xOffset.bandwidth()) / 2)
        .attr("x2", d => x(d["Cylinders"]) + xOffset(d["Origin"]) + xOffset.bandwidth() / 2 + (xOffset.bandwidth()) / 2)
        .attr("y1", d => y(d.median))
        .attr("y2", d => y(d.median))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
        .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("circle")
      .data(boxStats.flatMap(d => d.outliers.map(v => ({...d, "Acceleration": v}))))
      .join("circle")
        .attr("cx", d => x(d["Cylinders"]) + xOffset(d["Origin"]) + xOffset.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("cy", d => y(d["Acceleration"]))
        .attr("r", 3)
  }

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

      .text("Species");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Body Mass (g)");

  {
    const boxStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["Species"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["Body Mass (g)"]).filter(v => v != null).sort(d3.ascending);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(values, 0.25), median = d3.quantile(values, 0.5), q3 = d3.quantile(values, 0.75);
      const iqr = q3 - q1;
      const lowerFence = q1 - Infinity * iqr, upperFence = q3 + Infinity * iqr;
      const within = values.filter(v => v >= lowerFence && v <= upperFence);
      return {
        ...rows[0],
        q1, median, q3,
        whiskerLow: within.length ? within[0] : q1,
        whiskerHigh: within.length ? within[within.length - 1] : q3,
        outliers: values.filter(v => v < lowerFence || v > upperFence),
      };
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("x2", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("y1", d => y(d.whiskerLow))
        .attr("y2", d => y(d.whiskerHigh))
    svg.append("g")
      .selectAll("rect")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("rect")
        .attr("fill", d => color(d["Species"]))
        .attr("x", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2 - (Math.min(x.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("width", d => Math.min(x.bandwidth(), 14))
        .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d.q1), y(d.q3)))
        .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d.q3) - y(d.q1)))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "white")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2 - (Math.min(x.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("x2", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2 + (Math.min(x.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("y1", d => y(d.median))
        .attr("y2", d => y(d.median))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
        .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("circle")
      .data(boxStats.flatMap(d => d.outliers.map(v => ({...d, "Body Mass (g)": v}))))
      .join("circle")
        .attr("cx", d => x(d["Species"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("cy", d => y(d["Body Mass (g)"]))
        .attr("r", 3)
  }

  return svg.node();
}
