// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/penguins.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Body Mass (g)"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Body Mass (g)"]));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_Body Mass (g)": d3.mean(rows, d => d["Body Mass (g)"])}), d => d["Species"], d => d["Body Mass (g)"]), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"Species": k1, "Body Mass (g)": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Body Mass (g)"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Species"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Body Mass (g)");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));

      const values = rows.map(d => d["Body Mass (g)"]).filter(v => v != null).sort(d3.ascending);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(values, 0.25), median = d3.quantile(values, 0.5), q3 = d3.quantile(values, 0.75);
      const iqr = q3 - q1;
      const lowerFence = q1 - 1.5 * iqr, upperFence = q3 + 1.5 * iqr;
      const within = values.filter(v => v >= lowerFence && v <= upperFence);
      return {
        ...rows[0],
        q1, median, q3,
        whiskerLow: within.length ? within[0] : q1,
        whiskerHigh: within.length ? within[within.length - 1] : q3,
        outliers: values.filter(v => v < lowerFence || v > upperFence),
      };
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => y(d["Species"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.whiskerLow))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.whiskerHigh))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
      .selectAll("rect")

      .join("rect")

        .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d.q1), x(d.q3)))

    svg.append("g")

        .attr("x1", d => x(d.median))

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/movies.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["IMDB Rating"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["IMDB Rating"]) && d["Rotten Tomatoes Rating"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]));
  data1 = d3.bin().value(d => d["IMDB Rating"]).thresholds(10)(data1).flatMap(xBin => d3.bin().value(d => d["Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]).thresholds(10)(xBin).filter(yBin => yBin.length > 0).map(yBin => ({"bin0_IMDB Rating": xBin.x0, "bin1_IMDB Rating": xBin.x1, "bin0_Rotten Tomatoes Rating": yBin.x0, "bin1_Rotten Tomatoes Rating": yBin.x1, count: yBin.length})));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["bin0_IMDB Rating"]), data1.map(d => d["bin1_IMDB Rating"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["bin0_Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]), data1.map(d => d["bin1_Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const size = d3.scaleSqrt(d3.extent(data1, d => d["count"]), [2, 20]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("IMDB Rating");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Rotten Tomatoes Rating");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => (x(d["bin0_IMDB Rating"]) + x(d["bin1_IMDB Rating"])) / 2)
      .attr("cy", d => (y(d["bin0_Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]) + y(d["bin1_Rotten Tomatoes Rating"])) / 2)
      .attr("r", d => Math.sqrt(size(d["count"]) / Math.PI));

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

async function chart_facetTemplate(container, options = {}, __facetRows, __facetColorDomain, __facetSizeDomain, __facetXDomain, __facetYDomain) {
  const width = options.width ?? 150;
  const height = options.height ?? 150;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = __facetRows;
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Year"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]) && d["Acceleration"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Acceleration"]) && d["Displacement"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Displacement"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  data1 = d3.bin().value(d => d["Displacement"]).thresholds(20)(data1).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_Displacement": bin.x0, "bin_Displacement_end": bin.x1})));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(__facetXDomain, [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(__facetYDomain, [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]);
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleSequential(__facetColorDomain, d3.interpolateBlues); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();
  const size = d3.scaleSqrt(__facetSizeDomain, [2, 20]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Year");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["Acceleration"]))
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Year"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]))
      .attr("r", d => Math.sqrt(size(d["bin_Displacement"]) / Math.PI));

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  // vl2d3: unsupported top-level composition "facet", splitting the shared data by facet value at runtime instead of code-generation time -- each panel shows a plain text header (the raw/timeUnit'd facet value), not Vega-Lite's own fully templated header (--ignore-unsupported)
  let facetData = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  const __facetColorDomain = d3.extent(facetData, d => d["Acceleration"]);
  const __facetSizeDomain = d3.extent(facetData, d => d["Displacement"]);
  const __facetXDomain = d3.extent(facetData, d => d["Year"]);
  const __facetYDomain = d3.extent(facetData, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]);
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "__facetKey": d["Weight_in_lbs"]}));
  const __facetGroups = Array.from(d3.group(facetData, d => d["__facetKey"]), ([key, rows]) => ({key, rows}));
  __facetGroups.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.key, b.key));
  const doc = container.ownerDocument;
  const wrap = doc.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, auto); gap: 4px;";
  container.appendChild(wrap);
  for (const {key, rows} of __facetGroups) {
    const panelWrap = doc.createElement("div");
    wrap.appendChild(panelWrap);
    const label = doc.createElement("div");
    label.style.cssText = "font-size: 11px; font-family: sans-serif;";
    label.textContent = String(key);
    panelWrap.appendChild(label);
    const panel = doc.createElement("div");
    panelWrap.appendChild(panel);
    await chart_facetTemplate(panel, {...options, width: 150, height: 150}, rows, __facetColorDomain, __facetSizeDomain, __facetXDomain, __facetYDomain);
  }
}


===== config_numberFormatType_tooltip.vl.json [EXEC] =====

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 150;
  const height = options.height ?? 150;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Year"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"average_Miles_per_Gallon": d3.mean(rows, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"])}), d => d["Year"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"Year": k1, ...vals}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["Year"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["average_Miles_per_Gallon"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["average_Miles_per_Gallon"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "average_Miles_per_Gallon_stack0": y0, "average_Miles_per_Gallon_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => +d["Year"]))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["average_Miles_per_Gallon_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["average_Miles_per_Gallon_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Year");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["average_Miles_per_Gallon_stack1"]), y(d["average_Miles_per_Gallon_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["average_Miles_per_Gallon_stack0"]) - y(d["average_Miles_per_Gallon_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["Year"]) - 2.5)
      .attr("width", 5);

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Year"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "year_Year": new Date(d["Year"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["year_Year"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Year");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles per Gallon (95% CIs)");

  {
    const errBand = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["year_Year"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]).filter(v => v != null);
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const stdev = d3.deviation(values) ?? 0;
      const stderr = stdev / Math.sqrt(values.length);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75);
      return {...rows[0], lower: mean - 1.96 * stderr, upper: mean + 1.96 * stderr};
    }).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year_Year"], b["year_Year"]));
    svg.append("path")
        .attr("fill", "black")
        .attr("fill-opacity", 0.3)
        .attr("d", d3.area().x(d => x(d["year_Year"])).y0(d => y(d.lower)).y1(d => y(d.upper))(errBand))
    svg.append("path")
        .attr("fill", "none")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
        .attr("stroke-opacity", 1)
        .attr("d", d3.line().x(d => x(d["year_Year"])).y(d => y(d.lower))(errBand))
    svg.append("path")
        .attr("fill", "none")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
        .attr("stroke-opacity", 1)
        .attr("d", d3.line().x(d => x(d["year_Year"])).y(d => y(d.upper))(errBand))
  }

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Year"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "year_Year": new Date(d["Year"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["year_Year"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Year");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles per Gallon (95% CIs)");

  {
    const errStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["year_Year"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]).filter(v => v != null);
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const stdev = d3.deviation(values) ?? 0;
      const stderr = stdev / Math.sqrt(values.length);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75);
      return {...rows[0], lower: mean - 1.96 * stderr, upper: mean + 1.96 * stderr};
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(errStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => y(d.lower))
        .attr("y2", d => y(d.upper))
        .attr("x1", d => x(d["year_Year"]))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d["year_Year"]))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(errStats.flatMap(d => [{...d, __v: d.lower}, {...d, __v: d.upper}]))
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => y(d.__v))
        .attr("y2", d => y(d.__v))
        .attr("x1", d => x(d["year_Year"]) - 4)
        .attr("x2", d => x(d["year_Year"]) + 4)
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.year == 2000);
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"min_people": d3.min(rows, d => d["people"]), "max_people": d3.max(rows, d => d["people"])}), d => d["age"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"age": k1, ...vals}));
  let data2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]));
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d.year == 2000);
  data2 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data2, rows => ({"min_people": d3.min(rows, d => d["people"])}), d => d["age"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"age": k1, ...vals}));
  let data3 = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data3 = data3.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]));
  data3 = data3.filter(d => d.year == 2000);
  data3 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data3, rows => ({"max_people": d3.max(rows, d => d["people"])}), d => d["age"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"age": k1, ...vals}));
  let data4 = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data4 = data4.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]));
  data4 = data4.filter(d => d.year == 2000);
  data4 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data4, rows => ({"mean_people": d3.mean(rows, d => d["people"])}), d => d["age"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"age": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([].concat(data1.map(d => d["age"]), data2.map(d => d["age"]), data3.map(d => d["age"]), data4.map(d => d["age"])))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["min_people"]), data1.map(d => d["max_people"]), data2.map(d => d["min_people"]), data3.map(d => d["max_people"]), data4.map(d => d["mean_people"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("age");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("population");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("stroke", "black")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(data1)
    .join("line")
      .attr("y1", d => y(d["min_people"]))
      .attr("y2", d => y(d["max_people"]))
      .attr("x1", d => x(d["age"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("x2", d => x(d["age"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2);

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("stroke", "black")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(data2)
    .join("line")
      .attr("x1", d => x(d["age"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2 - x.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("x2", d => x(d["age"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2 + x.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("y1", d => y(d["min_people"]))
      .attr("y2", d => y(d["min_people"]));

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("stroke", "black")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(data3)
    .join("line")
      .attr("x1", d => x(d["age"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2 - x.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("x2", d => x(d["age"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2 + x.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("y1", d => y(d["max_people"]))
      .attr("y2", d => y(d["max_people"]));

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data4)
    .join("circle")

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {

  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]));

  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"min_people": d3.min(rows, d => d["people"]), "max_people": d3.max(rows, d => d["people"])}), d => d["age"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"age": k1, ...vals}));

  data4 = data4.filter(d => d.year == 2000);

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["min_people"]), data1.map(d => d["max_people"]), data2.map(d => d["min_people"]), data3.map(d => d["max_people"]), data4.map(d => d["mean_people"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([].concat(data1.map(d => d["age"]), data2.map(d => d["age"]), data3.map(d => d["age"]), data4.map(d => d["age"])))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/barley.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["yield"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yield"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["yield"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["variety"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("yield");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("variety");

  {
    const errStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["variety"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["yield"]).filter(v => v != null);
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const stdev = d3.deviation(values) ?? 0;
      const stderr = stdev / Math.sqrt(values.length);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75);
      return {...rows[0], lower: mean - stderr, upper: mean + stderr};
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(errStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.lower))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.upper))
        .attr("y1", d => y(d["variety"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => y(d["variety"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

async function chart_facetTemplate(container, options = {}, __facetRows, __facetColorDomain) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = __facetRows;
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]) && d["gender"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["gender"]));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_people": d3.sum(rows, d => d["people"])}), d => d["age"], d => d["gender"]), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"age": k1, "gender": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["age"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["gender"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["age"], d["gender"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"age": __c, "gender": __g, "sum_people": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["age"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["gender"], b["gender"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["sum_people"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["sum_people"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "sum_people_stack0": y0, "sum_people_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["age"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_people_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_people_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(__facetColorDomain, ["#675193", "#ca8861"]); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("age");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("population");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["gender"]))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["sum_people_stack1"]), y(d["sum_people_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["sum_people_stack0"]) - y(d["sum_people_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["age"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth());

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  // vl2d3: unsupported top-level composition "facet", splitting the shared data by facet value at runtime instead of code-generation time -- each panel shows a plain text header (the raw/timeUnit'd facet value), not Vega-Lite's own fully templated header (--ignore-unsupported)
  let facetData = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  facetData = facetData.filter(d => d.year == 2000);
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "gender": (d.sex == 2 ? 'Female' : 'Male')}));
  const __facetColorDomain = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(facetData.map(d => d["gender"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b));
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "__facetKey": d["gender"]}));
  const __facetGroups = Array.from(d3.group(facetData, d => d["__facetKey"]), ([key, rows]) => ({key, rows}));
  __facetGroups.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.key, b.key));
  const doc = container.ownerDocument;
  const wrap = doc.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 4px;";
  container.appendChild(wrap);
  for (const {key, rows} of __facetGroups) {
    const panelWrap = doc.createElement("div");
    wrap.appendChild(panelWrap);
    const label = doc.createElement("div");
    label.style.cssText = "font-size: 11px; font-family: sans-serif;";
    label.textContent = String(key);
    panelWrap.appendChild(label);
    const panel = doc.createElement("div");
    panelWrap.appendChild(panel);
    const __panelWidth = 17 * new d3.InternSet(rows.map(d => d["age"])).size;
    await chart_facetTemplate(panel, {...options, width: __panelWidth, ...(__panelWidth < 50 ? {marginLeft: Math.max(1, Math.round(__panelWidth * 0.3)), marginRight: Math.max(1, Math.round(__panelWidth * 0.1))} : {})}, rows, __facetColorDomain);
  }
}

      .attr("x", width - marginRight)

      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("IMDB Rating");

  svg.append("g")

      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/movies.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  const data1_IMDB_Rating_bins = d3.bin().value(d => d["IMDB Rating"]).thresholds(20)(data1);
  data1 = data1_IMDB_Rating_bins.map(bin => ({"bin0_IMDB Rating": bin.x0, "bin1_IMDB Rating": bin.x1, "count": bin.length}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["bin0_IMDB Rating"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["count"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["count"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "count_stack0": y0, "count_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([].concat(data1.map(d => d["bin0_IMDB Rating"]), data1.map(d => d["bin1_IMDB Rating"])))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["count_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["count_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("IMDB Rating");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d["bin0_IMDB Rating"]), x(d["bin1_IMDB Rating"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d["bin1_IMDB Rating"]) - x(d["bin0_IMDB Rating"])))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["count_stack1"]), y(d["count_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["count_stack0"]) - y(d["count_stack1"])));

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = d3.bin().value(d => d["Horsepower"]).thresholds(20)(data1).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_Horsepwoer": bin.x0, "bin_Horsepwoer_end": bin.x1})));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"bin_Horsepwoer": rows[0]["bin_Horsepwoer"], "bin_Horsepwoer_end": rows[0]["bin_Horsepwoer_end"], "Count": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["bin_Horsepwoer"], d["bin_Horsepwoer_end"]])).values());
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => 0).values()).flatMap(rows => {
  const n = rows.length;
  return rows.map((d, i) => ({...d, "TotalCount": d3.sum(rows, r => r["Count"])}));
});
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "PercentOfTotal": (d.Count/d.TotalCount)}));
  data1 = d3.bin().value(d => d["bin_Horsepwoer"]).thresholds(20)(data1).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_bin_Horsepwoer": bin.x0, "bin_bin_Horsepwoer_end": bin.x1})));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["bin_bin_Horsepwoer"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["PercentOfTotal"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["PercentOfTotal"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "PercentOfTotal_stack0": y0, "PercentOfTotal_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["bin_bin_Horsepwoer"]), data1.map(d => d["bin_bin_Horsepwoer_end"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["PercentOfTotal_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["PercentOfTotal_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Relative Frequency");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Horsepower"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => "grey")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]))
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  return svg.node();
}


===== interactive_legend.vl.json [EXEC] =====
404 Not Found
// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 300;
  const height = options.height ?? 200;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/unemployment-across-industries.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["series"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["series"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_count": d3.sum(rows, d => d["count"])}), d => d["series"], d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"series": k1, "yearmonth_date": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["yearmonth_date"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["series"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["yearmonth_date"], d["series"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"yearmonth_date": __c, "series": __g, "sum_count": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["yearmonth_date"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["series"], b["series"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["sum_count"]);
      let acc = 0;
      return rows.map(d => {
        const y0 = acc;
      acc += +d["sum_count"];
      const y1 = acc;
        return {...d, "sum_count_stack0": y0 - total / 2, "sum_count_stack1": y1 - total / 2};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => +d["yearmonth_date"]))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_count_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_count_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["series"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.2)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["series"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("fill", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.area().defined(d => d["yearmonth_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yearmonth_date"]) && d["sum_count_stack1"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["sum_count_stack1"]) && d["sum_count_stack0"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["sum_count_stack0"])).x(d => x(d["yearmonth_date"])).y0(d => y(d["sum_count_stack0"])).y1(d => y(d["sum_count_stack1"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["yearmonth_date"], b["yearmonth_date"]))));

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;

  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "yearmonthdate_date": new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), d["date"].getDate())}));
  let data2 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data2 = data2.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data2 = data2.map(d => ({...d, "yearmonthdate_date": new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), d["date"].getDate())}));
  let data3 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data3 = data3.filter(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]));
  data3 = data3.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data3 = data3.map(d => ({...d, "yearmonthdate_date": new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), d["date"].getDate())}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["yearmonthdate_date"]), data2.map(d => d["yearmonthdate_date"]), data3.map(d => d["yearmonthdate_date"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["temp_max"]), data2.map(d => d["temp_min"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("temp_max");

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "orange")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["yearmonthdate_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yearmonthdate_date"]) && d["temp_max"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["temp_max"])).x(d => x(d["yearmonthdate_date"])).y(d => y(d["temp_max"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["yearmonthdate_date"], b["yearmonthdate_date"]))));

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "red")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["yearmonthdate_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yearmonthdate_date"]) && d["temp_min"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["temp_min"])).x(d => x(d["yearmonthdate_date"])).y(d => y(d["temp_min"]))(data2.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["yearmonthdate_date"], b["yearmonthdate_date"]))));

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(data3)
    .join("line")
      .attr("stroke", d => "transparent")
      .attr("x1", d => x(d["yearmonthdate_date"]))
      .attr("x2", d => x(d["yearmonthdate_date"]))
      .attr("y1", marginTop)
      .attr("y2", Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom));

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]) && d["Cylinders"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Cylinders"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Horsepower"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const size = d3.scaleSqrt(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Cylinders"]), [2, 20]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]))
      .attr("r", d => Math.sqrt(size(d["Cylinders"]) / Math.PI));

  return svg.node();
}

===== joinaggregate_mean_difference.vl.json [EXEC] =====
404 Not Found
// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/movies.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["IMDB Rating"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["IMDB Rating"]));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d['IMDB Rating'] != null);
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => 0).values()).flatMap(rows => {
  const n = rows.length;
  return rows.map((d, i) => ({...d, "AverageRating": d3.mean(rows, r => r["IMDB Rating"])}));
});
  data1 = data1.filter(d => (d['IMDB Rating'] - d.AverageRating) > 2.5);
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["Title"]), ([, rows]) => {

      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "IMDB Rating_stack0": y0, "IMDB Rating_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  data2 = data2.filter(d => d['IMDB Rating'] != null);
  data2 = Array.from(d3.group(data2, d => 0).values()).flatMap(rows => {
  const n = rows.length;
  return rows.map((d, i) => ({...d, "AverageRating": d3.mean(rows, r => r["IMDB Rating"])}));

  data2 = [(rows => ({"average_AverageRating": d3.mean(rows, d => d["AverageRating"])}))(data2)];

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["IMDB Rating_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["IMDB Rating_stack1"]), data2.map(d => d["average_AverageRating"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();

  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "mean_IMDB Rating_stack0": y0, "mean_IMDB Rating_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();
  let data2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/movies.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data2 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data2, rows => ({"count": rows.length}), d => d["Major Genre"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"Major Genre": k1, ...vals}));

    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 500;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]));
  let data2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["people"]), data2.map(d => d["people"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([].concat(data1.map(d => d["age"]), data2.map(d => d["age"])))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("population");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("age");

  {
    const boxStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["age"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["people"]).filter(v => v != null).sort(d3.ascending);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(values, 0.25), median = d3.quantile(values, 0.5), q3 = d3.quantile(values, 0.75);
      const iqr = q3 - q1;
      const lowerFence = q1 - 1.5 * iqr, upperFence = q3 + 1.5 * iqr;
      const within = values.filter(v => v >= lowerFence && v <= upperFence);
      return {
        ...rows[0],
        q1, median, q3,
        whiskerLow: within.length ? within[0] : q1,
        whiskerHigh: within.length ? within[within.length - 1] : q3,
        outliers: values.filter(v => v < lowerFence || v > upperFence),
      };
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => y(d["age"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => y(d["age"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.whiskerLow))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.whiskerHigh))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
      .selectAll("rect")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("rect")
        .attr("y", d => y(d["age"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 - (Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("height", d => Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14))
        .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d.q1), x(d.q3)))
        .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d.q3) - x(d.q1)))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "white")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(boxStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("y1", d => y(d["age"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 - (Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => y(d["age"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 + (Math.min(y.bandwidth(), 14)) / 2)
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.median))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.median))
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
        .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("circle")
      .data(boxStats.flatMap(d => d.outliers.map(v => ({...d, "people": v}))))
      .join("circle")
        .attr("cy", d => y(d["age"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("cx", d => x(d["people"]))
        .attr("r", 3)
  }

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data2)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => "black")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["people"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["age"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("r", d => 3)
      .attr("opacity", d => 0.2);

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 400;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/ohlc.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["low"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["low"]) && d["high"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["high"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  let data2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/ohlc.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["open"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["open"]) && d["close"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["close"]));
  data2 = data2.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(([].concat(data1.map(d => d["date"]), data2.map(d => d["date"]))).map(v => +v))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["low"]), data1.map(d => d["high"]), data2.map(d => d["open"]), data2.map(d => d["close"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Date in 2009");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("low");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(data1)
    .join("line")

      .attr("y1", d => y(d["low"]))

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Acceleration"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Acceleration"]) && d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]));
  data1 = d3.bin().value(d => d["Acceleration"]).thresholds(20)(data1).flatMap(xBin => d3.bin().value(d => d["Horsepower"]).thresholds(20)(xBin).filter(yBin => yBin.length > 0).map(yBin => ({"bin0_Acceleration": xBin.x0, "bin1_Acceleration": xBin.x1, "bin0_Horsepower": yBin.x0, "bin1_Horsepower": yBin.x1, count: yBin.length})));
  let data2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d["Acceleration"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Acceleration"]) && d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]));
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d.Origin === 'Japan');
  data2 = d3.bin().value(d => d["Acceleration"]).thresholds(20)(data2).flatMap(xBin => d3.bin().value(d => d["Horsepower"]).thresholds(20)(xBin).filter(yBin => yBin.length > 0).map(yBin => ({"bin0_Acceleration": xBin.x0, "bin1_Acceleration": xBin.x1, "bin0_Horsepower": yBin.x0, "bin1_Horsepower": yBin.x1, count: yBin.length})));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["bin0_Acceleration"]), data1.map(d => d["bin1_Acceleration"]), data2.map(d => d["bin0_Acceleration"]), data2.map(d => d["bin1_Acceleration"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["bin0_Horsepower"]), data1.map(d => d["bin1_Horsepower"]), data2.map(d => d["bin0_Horsepower"]), data2.map(d => d["bin1_Horsepower"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const size = d3.scaleSqrt(d3.extent([...data1, ...data2], d => d["count"]), [2, 20]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Acceleration");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => (x(d["bin0_Acceleration"]) + x(d["bin1_Acceleration"])) / 2)
      .attr("cy", d => (y(d["bin0_Horsepower"]) + y(d["bin1_Horsepower"])) / 2)
      .attr("r", d => Math.sqrt(size(d["count"]) / Math.PI));

  svg.append("g")

    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data2)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => "firebrick")
      .attr("cx", d => (x(d["bin0_Acceleration"]) + x(d["bin1_Acceleration"])) / 2)
      .attr("cy", d => (y(d["bin0_Horsepower"]) + y(d["bin1_Horsepower"])) / 2)
      .attr("r", d => Math.sqrt(size(d["count"]) / Math.PI));

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;

  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"bin_IMDB_Rating": rows[0]["bin_IMDB_Rating"], "bin_IMDB_Rating_end": rows[0]["bin_IMDB_Rating_end"], "count": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["bin_IMDB_Rating"], d["bin_IMDB_Rating_end"]])).values());

  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => 0).values()).flatMap(rows => {
  const cmp = (a, b) => (a["bin_IMDB_Rating"] > b["bin_IMDB_Rating"] ? 1 : a["bin_IMDB_Rating"] < b["bin_IMDB_Rating"] ? -1 : 0);
  rows = rows.slice().sort(cmp);
  const n = rows.length;
  return rows.map((d, i) => ({...d, "Cumulative Count": d3.sum(rows.slice(0, i + 1), r => r["count"])}));
});
  data1 = d3.bin().value(d => d["bin_IMDB_Rating"]).thresholds(20)(data1).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_bin_IMDB_Rating": bin.x0, "bin_bin_IMDB_Rating_end": bin.x1})));

      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["Cumulative Count"]);

      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["Cumulative Count"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "Cumulative Count_stack0": y0, "Cumulative Count_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "count_stack0": y0, "count_stack1": y1};
      });

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)

      .attr("x", width - marginRight)

    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d["bin_bin_IMDB_Rating"]), x(d["bin_bin_IMDB_Rating_end"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d["bin_bin_IMDB_Rating_end"]) - x(d["bin_bin_IMDB_Rating"])))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["Cumulative Count_stack1"]), y(d["Cumulative Count_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["Cumulative Count_stack0"]) - y(d["Cumulative Count_stack1"])));

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "yellow")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data2)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d["bin_bin_IMDB_Rating"]), x(d["bin_bin_IMDB_Rating_end"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d["bin_bin_IMDB_Rating_end"]) - x(d["bin_bin_IMDB_Rating"])))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["count_stack1"]), y(d["count_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["count_stack0"]) - y(d["count_stack1"])));

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 400;
  const height = options.height ?? 300;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.location == "Seattle");
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"average_temp_max": d3.mean(rows, d => d["temp_max"]), "average_temp_min": d3.mean(rows, d => d["temp_min"])}), d => new Date(2012, d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"month_date": k1, ...vals}));
  let data2 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data2 = data2.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d.location == "Seattle");
  data2 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data2, rows => ({"average_precipitation": d3.mean(rows, d => d["precipitation"])}), d => new Date(2012, d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"month_date": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(([].concat(data1.map(d => d["month_date"]), data2.map(d => d["month_date"]))).map(v => +v))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear([0, 30], [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Avg. Temperature (°C)");

  svg.append("path")

      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.3)
      .attr("d", d3.area().defined(d => d["month_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["month_date"]) && d["average_temp_max"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["average_temp_max"]) && d["average_temp_min"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["average_temp_min"])).x(d => x(d["month_date"])).y0(d => y(d["average_temp_min"])).y1(d => y(d["average_temp_max"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["month_date"], b["month_date"]))));

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "#85A9C5")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["month_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["month_date"]) && d["average_precipitation"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["average_precipitation"])).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX).x(d => x(d["month_date"])).y(d => y(d["average_precipitation"]))(data2.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["month_date"], b["month_date"]))));

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  let data2 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"]) && d["symbol"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["symbol"]));
  data2 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data2, rows => ({"mean_price": d3.mean(rows, d => d["price"])}), d => d["symbol"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"symbol": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent([...data1, ...data2], d => d["date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["price"]), data2.map(d => d["mean_price"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([...data1, ...data2].map(d => d["symbol"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["symbol"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("stroke", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.line().defined(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"])).x(d => x(d["date"])).y(d => y(d["price"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["date"], b["date"]))));

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(data2)
    .join("line")
      .attr("stroke", d => color(d["symbol"]))
      .attr("y1", d => y(d["mean_price"]))
      .attr("y2", d => y(d["mean_price"]))
      .attr("x1", marginLeft)
      .attr("x2", Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight));

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Year"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "year_Year": new Date(d["Year"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)}));
  let data2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data2 = data2.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  data2 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data2, rows => ({"mean_Miles_per_Gallon": d3.mean(rows, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"])}), d => new Date(d["Year"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"year_Year": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["year_Year"]), data2.map(d => d["year_Year"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), data2.map(d => d["mean_Miles_per_Gallon"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Year");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  {
    const errBand = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["year_Year"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]).filter(v => v != null);
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const stdev = d3.deviation(values) ?? 0;
      const stderr = stdev / Math.sqrt(values.length);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75);
      return {...rows[0], lower: mean - 1.96 * stderr, upper: mean + 1.96 * stderr};
    }).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year_Year"], b["year_Year"]));
    svg.append("path")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
        .attr("fill-opacity", 0.3)
        .attr("d", d3.area().x(d => x(d["year_Year"])).y0(d => y(d.lower)).y1(d => y(d.upper))(errBand))
    svg.append("path")
        .attr("fill", "none")
        .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
        .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.5)
        .attr("stroke-dasharray", "6,4")
        .attr("d", d3.line().x(d => x(d["year_Year"])).y(d => y(d.lower))(errBand))
    svg.append("path")
        .attr("fill", "none")
        .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
        .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.5)
        .attr("stroke-dasharray", "6,4")
        .attr("d", d3.line().x(d => x(d["year_Year"])).y(d => y(d.upper))(errBand))
  }

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["year_Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["year_Year"]) && d["mean_Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["mean_Miles_per_Gallon"])).x(d => x(d["year_Year"])).y(d => y(d["mean_Miles_per_Gallon"]))(data2.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year_Year"], b["year_Year"]))));

  return svg.node();
}
