      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Mean of Miles per Gallon (95% CIs)");

  {
    const errBand = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["year_Year"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]).filter(v => v != null);
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const stdev = d3.deviation(values) ?? 0;
      const stderr = stdev / Math.sqrt(values.length);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75);
      return {...rows[0], lower: mean - 1.96 * stderr, upper: mean + 1.96 * stderr};
    }).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year_Year"], b["year_Year"]));
    svg.append("path")
        .attr("fill", "steelblue")
        .attr("fill-opacity", 0.3)
        .attr("d", d3.area().x(d => x(d["year_Year"])).y0(d => y(d.lower)).y1(d => y(d.upper))(errBand))
  }

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["year_Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["year_Year"]) && d["mean_Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["mean_Miles_per_Gallon"])).x(d => x(d["year_Year"])).y(d => y(d["mean_Miles_per_Gallon"]))(data2.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year_Year"], b["year_Year"]))));

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.symbol==='GOOG');
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "year_date": new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)}));
  let data2 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data2 = data2.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d.symbol==='GOOG');
  data2 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data2, rows => ({"mean_price": d3.mean(rows, d => d["price"])}), d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"year_date": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["year_date"]), data2.map(d => d["year_date"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["price"]), data2.map(d => d["mean_price"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["year_date"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["price"]))
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")

  return svg.node();

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/barley.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["yield"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yield"]));
  let data2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/barley.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d["yield"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yield"]));
  data2 = [(rows => ({"mean_yield": d3.mean(rows, d => d["yield"])}))(data2)];

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["yield"]), data2.map(d => d["mean_yield"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("yield");

  {
    const errStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => 0), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["yield"]).filter(v => v != null);
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const stdev = d3.deviation(values) ?? 0;
      const stderr = stdev / Math.sqrt(values.length);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75);
      return {...rows[0], lower: mean - stderr, upper: mean + stderr};
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(errStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.lower))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.upper))
        .attr("y1", d => height / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => height / 2)
  }

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "black")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data2)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["mean_yield"]))
      .attr("cy", d => height / 2)
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  return svg.node();
}

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("yield");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("variety");

  {
    const errStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["variety"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["yield"]).filter(v => v != null);
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const stdev = d3.deviation(values) ?? 0;
      const stderr = stdev / Math.sqrt(values.length);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75);
      return {...rows[0], lower: mean - 1.96 * stderr, upper: mean + 1.96 * stderr};
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(errStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.lower))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.upper))
        .attr("y1", d => y(d["variety"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => y(d["variety"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
  }

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "black")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data2)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["mean_yield"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["variety"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  return svg.node();
}

  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")

      .text("yield");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("variety");

  {
    const errStats = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["variety"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["yield"]).filter(v => v != null);
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const stdev = d3.deviation(values) ?? 0;
      const stderr = stdev / Math.sqrt(values.length);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75);

        .attr("y2", d => y(d["variety"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)

      .selectAll("line")
      .data(errStats.flatMap(d => [{...d, __v: d.lower}, {...d, __v: d.upper}]))
      .join("line")
        .attr("stroke", d => "#4682b4")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.__v))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.__v))

      .attr("cx", d => x(d["mean_yield"]))

  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([].concat(data1.map(d => d["variety"]), data2.map(d => d["variety"])))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Barley Yield");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("variety");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => "black")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["mean_yield"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["variety"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  {
    const errStats = Array.from(d3.group(data2, d => JSON.stringify([d["variety"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const values = rows.map(d => d["yield"]).filter(v => v != null);
      const sorted = values.slice().sort(d3.ascending);
      const mean = d3.mean(values);
      const stdev = d3.deviation(values) ?? 0;
      const stderr = stdev / Math.sqrt(values.length);
      const q1 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3 = d3.quantile(sorted, 0.75);
      return {...rows[0], lower: mean - 1.96 * stderr, upper: mean + 1.96 * stderr};
    });
    svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "black")
      .selectAll("line")
      .data(errStats)
      .join("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d.lower))
        .attr("x2", d => x(d.upper))
        .attr("y1", d => y(d["variety"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
        .attr("y2", d => y(d["variety"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["precipitation"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["precipitation"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_precipitation": d3.mean(rows, d => d["precipitation"])}), d => new Date(2012, d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"month_date": k1, ...vals}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["month_date"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["mean_precipitation"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["mean_precipitation"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "mean_precipitation_stack0": y0, "mean_precipitation_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();
  let data2 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data2 = data2.filter(d => d["precipitation"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["precipitation"]));
  data2 = [(rows => ({"mean_precipitation": d3.mean(rows, d => d["precipitation"])}))(data2)];

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([...data1, ...data2].map(d => d["month_date"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["mean_precipitation_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["mean_precipitation_stack1"]), data2.map(d => d["mean_precipitation"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("precipitation");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["mean_precipitation_stack1"]), y(d["mean_precipitation_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["mean_precipitation_stack0"]) - y(d["mean_precipitation_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["month_date"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth());

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(data2)
    .join("line")
      .attr("stroke", d => "red")
      .attr("y1", d => y(d["mean_precipitation"]))
      .attr("y2", d => y(d["mean_precipitation"]))
      .attr("x1", marginLeft)
      .attr("x2", Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight));

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["price"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["symbol"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["symbol"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("stroke", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.line().defined(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"])).x(d => x(d["date"])).y(d => y(d["price"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["date"], b["date"]))));

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"Origin": rows[0]["Origin"], "Cylinders": rows[0]["Cylinders"], "num_cars": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["Origin"], d["Cylinders"]])).values());
  let data2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data2 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data2, rows => ({"Origin": rows[0]["Origin"], "Cylinders": rows[0]["Cylinders"], "num_cars": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["Origin"], d["Cylinders"]])).values());

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([].concat(data1.map(d => d["Cylinders"]), data2.map(d => d["Cylinders"])))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([].concat(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]), data2.map(d => d["Origin"])))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleSequential(d3.extent([...data1, ...data2], d => d["num_cars"]), d3.interpolateBlues); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Cylinders");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Origin");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["num_cars"]))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["Cylinders"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth())
      .attr("y", d => y(d["Origin"]))
      .attr("height", y.bandwidth());

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(data2)
    .join("text")
      .attr("fill", d => (d['num_cars'] < 40) ? ("black") : ("white"))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["Cylinders"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("y", d => y(d["Origin"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("dy", "0.32em")
      .text(d => d["num_cars"]);

  return svg.node();
}

  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => 0).values()).flatMap(rows => {
  const n = rows.length;
  return rows.map((d, i) => ({...d, "max_num_cars": d3.max(rows, r => r["num_cars"])}));
});

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "temp_range": (d.temp_max - d.temp_min)}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_temp_range": d3.mean(rows, d => d["temp_range"])}), d => new Date(2012, d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"month_date": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["month_date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["mean_temp_range"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)

      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("temp_range");

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["month_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["month_date"]) && d["mean_temp_range"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["mean_temp_range"])).x(d => x(d["month_date"])).y(d => y(d["mean_temp_range"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["month_date"], b["month_date"]))));

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Acceleration"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Acceleration"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  const data1_Acceleration_bins = d3.bin().value(d => d["Acceleration"]).thresholds(20)(data1);
  data1 = data1_Acceleration_bins.flatMap(bin => Array.from(d3.rollup(bin, rows => ({"mean_Horsepower": d3.mean(rows, d => d["Horsepower"])}), d => d["Year"]), ([key, vals]) => ({"bin0_Acceleration": bin.x0, "bin1_Acceleration": bin.x1, "Year": key, ...vals})));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Year"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["mean_Horsepower"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["bin0_Acceleration"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

      .attr("font-size", "11px")

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
    .selectAll("path")

import * as d3 from "d3";
// NOTE: this file depends on vl2d3-runtime.js (a copy of vl2d3's own src/runtime.js) --
// it is not a fully standalone snippet; keep that file alongside this one.
import {vlPivot} from "./vl2d3-runtime.js";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = vlPivot(data1, {field: "symbol", value: "price", groupby: ["date"]});
  let data2 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data2 = data2.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data2 = vlPivot(data2, {field: "symbol", value: "price", groupby: ["date"]});
  let data3 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data3 = data3.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data3 = vlPivot(data3, {field: "symbol", value: "price", groupby: ["date"]});

  data4 = vlPivot(data4, {field: "symbol", value: "price", groupby: ["date"]});

  data7 = vlPivot(data7, {field: "symbol", value: "price", groupby: ["date"]});

  data8 = data8.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data8 = vlPivot(data8, {field: "symbol", value: "price", groupby: ["date"]});
  let data9 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data9 = data9.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data9 = vlPivot(data9, {field: "symbol", value: "price", groupby: ["date"]});
  let data10 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data10 = data10.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data10 = vlPivot(data10, {field: "symbol", value: "price", groupby: ["date"]});

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["date"]), data2.map(d => d["date"]), data3.map(d => d["date"]), data4.map(d => d["date"]), data5.map(d => d["date"]), data6.map(d => d["date"]), data7.map(d => d["date"]), data8.map(d => d["date"]), data9.map(d => d["date"]), data10.map(d => d["date"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["AAPL"]), data2.map(d => d["AAPL"]), data3.map(d => d["AMZN"]), data4.map(d => d["AMZN"]), data5.map(d => d["GOOG"]), data6.map(d => d["GOOG"]), data7.map(d => d["IBM"]), data8.map(d => d["IBM"]), data9.map(d => d["MSFT"]), data10.map(d => d["MSFT"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(["AAPL", "AMZN", "GOOG", "IBM", "MSFT"], d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

      .text("date");

      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "white")
      .attr("stroke-width", 4)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["AAPL"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["AAPL"])).x(d => x(d["date"])).y(d => y(d["AAPL"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["date"], b["date"]))));

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "white")

      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["MSFT"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["MSFT"])).x(d => x(d["date"])).y(d => y(d["MSFT"]))(data9.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["date"], b["date"]))));

      .attr("fill", "none")

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 400;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.symbol==='GOOG');
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["date"].getFullYear() >= 2006 && d["date"].getFullYear() <= 2007);

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["price"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"])).x(d => x(d["date"])).y(d => y(d["price"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["date"], b["date"]))));

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["price"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["symbol"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("stroke", ([key]) => "steelblue")
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.line().defined(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"])).x(d => x(d["date"])).y(d => y(d["price"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["date"], b["date"]))));

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"max_temp_max": d3.max(rows, d => d["temp_max"])}), d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"yearmonth_date": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["yearmonth_date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["max_temp_max"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("temp_max");

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["yearmonth_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yearmonth_date"]) && d["max_temp_max"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["max_temp_max"])).x(d => x(d["yearmonth_date"])).y(d => y(d["max_temp_max"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["yearmonth_date"], b["yearmonth_date"]))));

  return svg.node();

===== line_month_center_band_offset.vl.json [EXEC] =====
404 Not Found
// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["precipitation"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["precipitation"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_precipitation": d3.mean(rows, d => d["precipitation"])}), d => new Date(2012, d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"month_date": k1, ...vals}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["month_date"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["mean_precipitation"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["mean_precipitation"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "mean_precipitation_stack0": y0, "mean_precipitation_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => +d["month_date"]))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["mean_precipitation_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["mean_precipitation_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("precipitation");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["mean_precipitation_stack1"]), y(d["mean_precipitation_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["mean_precipitation_stack0"]) - y(d["mean_precipitation_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["month_date"]) - 2.5)
      .attr("width", 5);

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.symbol==='GOOG');
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["date"].getFullYear() === 2006);
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"average_price": d3.mean(rows, d => d["price"])}), d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), Math.floor(d["date"].getMonth() / 3) * 3, 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"yearquarter_date": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["yearquarter_date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["average_price"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["yearquarter_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yearquarter_date"]) && d["average_price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["average_price"])).x(d => x(d["yearquarter_date"])).y(d => y(d["average_price"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["yearquarter_date"], b["yearquarter_date"]))));

  return svg.node();

===== line_overlay.vl.json [EXEC] =====
404 Not Found
// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_price": d3.mean(rows, d => d["price"])}), d => d["symbol"], d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"symbol": k1, "year_date": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["year_date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["mean_price"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["symbol"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["symbol"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("stroke", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.line().defined(d => d["year_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["year_date"]) && d["mean_price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["mean_price"])).x(d => x(d["year_date"])).y(d => y(d["mean_price"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year_date"], b["year_date"]))));

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["site"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("year");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("yield");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["site"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("stroke", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.line().defined(d => d["year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["year"]) && d["median_yield"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["median_yield"])).x(d => x(d["year"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2).y(d => y(d["median_yield"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year"], b["year"]))));

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.symbol==='GOOG');

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["price"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"])).curve(d3.curveStepAfter).x(d => x(d["date"])).y(d => y(d["price"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["date"], b["date"]))));

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "month": new Date(d["month"]), "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "month": new Date(2012, d["date"].getMonth(), 1)}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"max_temp_max": d3.max(rows, d => d["temp_max"])}), d => d["month"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"month": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["month"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["max_temp_max"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("month");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("temp_max");

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["month"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["month"]) && d["max_temp_max"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["max_temp_max"])).x(d => x(d["month"])).y(d => y(d["max_temp_max"]))(data1.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["month"], b["month"]))));

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {

  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;

  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["IMDB Rating"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["IMDB Rating"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["IMDB Rating"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")

  return svg.node();

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]) && d["Acceleration"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Acceleration"]));
  data1 = d3.bin().value(d => d["Acceleration"]).thresholds(20)(data1).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_Acceleration": bin.x0, "bin_Acceleration_end": bin.x1})));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Horsepower"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const size = d3.scaleSqrt(d3.extent(data1, d => d["bin_Acceleration"]), [2, 20]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]))
      .attr("r", d => Math.sqrt(size(d["bin_Acceleration"]) / Math.PI));

  return svg.node();

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Horsepower"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["Origin"]))
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]))
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Horsepower"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  {
    const pointSymbol = d3.symbol().type(d3.symbolSquare).size(d => Math.PI * Math.pow(3, 2));
    svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("path")
      .data(data1)
      .join("path")
        .attr("fill", d => "#ff9900")
        .attr("transform", d => "translate(" + (x(d["Horsepower"])) + "," + (y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"])) + ")")
        .attr("d", pointSymbol)
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/penguins.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Flipper Length (mm)"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Flipper Length (mm)"]) && d["Body Mass (g)"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Body Mass (g)"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Flipper Length (mm)"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Body Mass (g)"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Species"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();
  const shape = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Species"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [d3.symbolCircle, d3.symbolSquare, d3.symbolCross, d3.symbolDiamond, d3.symbolTriangle, d3.symbolTriangle2, d3.symbolStar, d3.symbolWye]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Flipper Length (mm)");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Body Mass (g)");

  {
    const pointSymbol = d3.symbol().type(d => shape(d["Species"])).size(d => Math.PI * Math.pow(3, 2));
    svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("path")
      .data(data1)
      .join("path")
        .attr("fill", d => color(d["Species"]))
        .attr("transform", d => "translate(" + (x(d["Flipper Length (mm)"])) + "," + (y(d["Body Mass (g)"])) + ")")
        .attr("d", pointSymbol)
  }

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]) && d["Acceleration"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Acceleration"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Horsepower"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Acceleration"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleSequential(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), d3.interpolateBlues); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();
  const size = d3.scaleSqrt(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [2, 20]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Acceleration");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]))
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Acceleration"]))
      .attr("r", d => Math.sqrt(size(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]) / Math.PI));

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["temp_max"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["temp_max"]) && d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_temp_max": d3.mean(rows, d => d["temp_max"])}), d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"yearmonth_date": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["mean_temp_max"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleSequential(d3.extent(data1, d => d["yearmonth_date"]), d3.interpolateBlues); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("temp_max");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["yearmonth_date"]))
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["mean_temp_max"]))
      .attr("cy", d => height / 2)
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {

  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;

  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "url": ('https://www.google.com/search?q=' + d.Name)}));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Horsepower"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]))

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "random": (Math.random())}));
  data1 = d3.bin().value(d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]).thresholds(20)(data1).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_Miles_per_Gallon": bin.x0, "bin_Miles_per_Gallon_end": bin.x1})));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Horsepower"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet([].concat(data1.map(d => d["bin_Miles_per_Gallon"]), data1.map(d => d["bin_Miles_per_Gallon_end"])))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("cy", d => (y(d["bin_Miles_per_Gallon"]) + y(d["bin_Miles_per_Gallon_end"])) / 2)

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]) && d["Weight_in_lbs"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Weight_in_lbs"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Horsepower"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Cylinders"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();
  const size = d3.scaleSqrt(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Weight_in_lbs"]), [2, 20]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["Cylinders"]))
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]))
      .attr("r", d => Math.sqrt(size(d["Weight_in_lbs"]) / Math.PI));

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 300;
  const height = options.height ?? 200;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/movies.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["IMDB Rating"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["IMDB Rating"]) && d["Rotten Tomatoes Rating"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => (d["IMDB Rating"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["IMDB Rating"])) && (d["Rotten Tomatoes Rating"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Rotten Tomatoes Rating"])));
  data1 = d3.bin().value(d => d["IMDB Rating"]).thresholds(60)(data1).flatMap(xBin => d3.bin().value(d => d["Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]).thresholds(40)(xBin).filter(yBin => yBin.length > 0).map(yBin => ({"bin0_IMDB Rating": xBin.x0, "bin1_IMDB Rating": xBin.x1, "bin0_Rotten Tomatoes Rating": yBin.x0, "bin1_Rotten Tomatoes Rating": yBin.x1, count: yBin.length})));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["bin0_IMDB Rating"]), data1.map(d => d["bin1_IMDB Rating"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["bin0_Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]), data1.map(d => d["bin1_Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleSequential(d3.extent(data1, d => d["count"]), d3.interpolateBlues); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("IMDB Rating");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Rotten Tomatoes Rating");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["count"]))
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d["bin0_IMDB Rating"]), x(d["bin1_IMDB Rating"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d["bin1_IMDB Rating"]) - x(d["bin0_IMDB Rating"])))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["bin0_Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]), y(d["bin1_Rotten Tomatoes Rating"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["bin1_Rotten Tomatoes Rating"]) - y(d["bin0_Rotten Tomatoes Rating"])));

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {

  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

      .attr("height", height)

  svg.append("g")

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)

  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)

      .text("Origin");

  svg.append("g")

  svg.append("text")

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 300;
  const height = options.height ?? 100;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.symbol !== 'GOOG');
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_price": d3.sum(rows, d => d["price"])}), d => d["symbol"], d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), d["date"].getDate())), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"symbol": k1, "yearmonthdate_date": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["yearmonthdate_date"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["symbol"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleSequential(d3.extent(data1, d => d["sum_price"]), d3.interpolateBlues); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Time");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("symbol");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
