===== rect_mosaic_simple.vl.json [EXEC] =====
404 Not Found
// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Cylinders"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Cylinders"]));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"Origin": rows[0]["Origin"], "Cylinders": rows[0]["Cylinders"], "count_*": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["Origin"], d["Cylinders"]])).values());
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => 0), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["count_*"]);
      let acc = 0;
      return rows.map(d => {
        const y0 = acc;
        acc += +d["count_*"];
        const y1 = acc;
        return {...d, "stack_count_Origin1": total ? y0 / total : 0, "stack_count_Origin2": total ? y1 / total : 0};
      });
    }).flat();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["Origin"]])).values()).flatMap(rows => {
  const n = rows.length;
  return rows.map((d, i) => ({...d, "x": d3.min(rows, r => r["stack_count_Origin1"]), "x2": d3.max(rows, r => r["stack_count_Origin2"])}));
});
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["Origin"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["count_*"]);
      let acc = 0;
      return rows.map(d => {
        const y0 = acc;
        acc += +d["count_*"];
        const y1 = acc;
        return {...d, "y": total ? y0 / total : 0, "y2": total ? y1 / total : 0};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["x"]), data1.map(d => d["x2"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["y"]), data1.map(d => d["y2"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();
  const opacity = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Cylinders"]), [0.1, 1]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["Origin"]))
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d["x"]), x(d["x2"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d["x2"]) - x(d["x"])))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["y"]), y(d["y2"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["y2"]) - y(d["y"])))
      .attr("opacity", d => opacity(d["Cylinders"]))
      .each(function(d) { d3.select(this).append("title").text(`Origin: ${d["Origin"]}\nCylinders: ${d["Cylinders"]}`); });

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {

  data1 = data1_IMDB_Rating_bins.map(bin => ({"bin0_IMDB Rating": bin.x0, "bin1_IMDB Rating": bin.x1, "mean_US Gross": d3.mean(bin, d => d["US Gross"])}));
  let data2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/movies.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  const data2_IMDB_Rating_bins = d3.bin().value(d => d["IMDB Rating"]).thresholds(20)(data2);
  data2 = data2_IMDB_Rating_bins.map(bin => ({"bin0_IMDB Rating": bin.x0, "bin1_IMDB Rating": bin.x1, "mean_Worldwide Gross": d3.mean(bin, d => d["Worldwide Gross"])}));

  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["mean_US Gross"]), data2.map(d => d["mean_Worldwide Gross"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Mean of US and Worldwide Gross");

      .attr("stroke", color("US Gross"))

  svg.append("path")
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", color("Worldwide Gross"))
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("d", d3.line().defined(d => d["bin0_IMDB Rating"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["bin0_IMDB Rating"]) && d["mean_Worldwide Gross"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["mean_Worldwide Gross"])).x(d => x(d["bin0_IMDB Rating"])).y(d => y(d["mean_Worldwide Gross"]))(data2.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["bin0_IMDB Rating"], b["bin0_IMDB Rating"]))));

  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": ((d.Year).getFullYear())}));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Horsepower"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => "grey")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]))
      .attr("r", d => 3.989422804014327);

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Cylinders"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Cylinders");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Origin");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => "grey")
      .attr("x", d => x(d["Cylinders"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth())
      .attr("y", d => y(d["Origin"]))
      .attr("height", y.bandwidth());

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {

  svg.append("g")

      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  {
    const pointSymbol = d3.symbol().type(d3.symbolCircle).size(d => Math.PI * Math.pow(3.989422804014327, 2));
    svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("path")
      .data(data1)
      .join("path")
        .attr("fill", d => "grey")
        .attr("transform", d => "translate(" + (x(d["Horsepower"])) + "," + (y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"])) + ")")
        .attr("d", pointSymbol)
  }

  return svg.node();

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]) && d["Cylinders"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Cylinders"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear([75, 150], [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear([20, 40], [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]);
  const size = d3.scaleSqrt(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Cylinders"]), [2, 20]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => "grey")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]))
      .attr("r", d => Math.sqrt(size(d["Cylinders"]) / Math.PI));

  return svg.node();
}

  const x = d3.scaleLinear([75, 150], [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear([20, 40], [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]);
  const size = d3.scaleSqrt(d3.extent(data1, d => d["Cylinders"]), [2, 20]);

      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)

      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 300;
  const height = options.height ?? 200;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/unemployment-across-industries.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["series"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["series"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_count": d3.sum(rows, d => d["count"])}), d => d["series"], d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"series": k1, "yearmonth_date": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["yearmonth_date"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["series"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["yearmonth_date"], d["series"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"yearmonth_date": __c, "series": __g, "sum_count": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["yearmonth_date"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["series"], b["series"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["sum_count"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["sum_count"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "sum_count_stack0": y0, "sum_count_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => +d["yearmonth_date"]))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_count_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_count_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["series"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("count");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.7)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["series"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("fill", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.area().defined(d => d["yearmonth_date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yearmonth_date"]) && d["sum_count_stack1"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["sum_count_stack1"]) && d["sum_count_stack0"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["sum_count_stack0"])).x(d => x(d["yearmonth_date"])).y0(d => y(d["sum_count_stack0"])).y1(d => y(d["sum_count_stack1"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["yearmonth_date"], b["yearmonth_date"]))));

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "Year": new Date(d["Year"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_Weight_in_lbs": d3.sum(rows, d => d["Weight_in_lbs"])}), d => d["Cylinders"], d => new Date(d["Year"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"Cylinders": k1, "year_Year": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["year_Year"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Cylinders"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["year_Year"], d["Cylinders"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"year_Year": __c, "Cylinders": __g, "sum_Weight_in_lbs": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["year_Year"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["Cylinders"], b["Cylinders"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["sum_Weight_in_lbs"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["sum_Weight_in_lbs"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0": y0, "sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleTime((() => { const xs = Array.from(new Set(data1.map(d => +d["year_Year"]))).sort((a, b) => a - b); const step = xs.length > 1 ? (xs[xs.length - 1] - xs[0]) / (xs.length - 1) : 0; return [new Date(xs[0] - step / 2), new Date(xs[xs.length - 1] + step / 2)]; })(), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Cylinders"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Year");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Weight_in_lbs");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.7)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["Cylinders"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("fill", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.area().defined(d => d["year_Year"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["year_Year"]) && d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1"]) && d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0"])).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX).x(d => x(d["year_Year"])).y0(d => y(d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack0"])).y1(d => y(d["sum_Weight_in_lbs_stack1"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["year_Year"], b["year_Year"]))));

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {

  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/unemployment-across-industries.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["series"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["series"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_count": d3.sum(rows, d => d["count"])}), d => d["series"], d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"series": k1, "yearmonth_date": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);

    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["yearmonth_date"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["series"])));

    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"yearmonth_date": __c, "series": __g, "sum_count": 0});

      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["series"], b["series"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["sum_count"]);
      let acc = 0;
      return rows.map(d => {
        const y0 = acc;
      acc += +d["sum_count"];
      const y1 = acc;
        return {...d, "sum_count_stack0": y0 - total / 2, "sum_count_stack1": y1 - total / 2};
      });
    }).flat();

  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["series"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)

      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.7)

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Acceleration"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Acceleration"]) && d["Origin"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Origin"]));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_Acceleration": d3.sum(rows, d => d["Acceleration"])}), d => d["Origin"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"Origin": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear([Math.min(0, d3.min(data1, d => d["sum_Acceleration"])), Math.max(0, d3.max(data1, d => d["sum_Acceleration"]))], [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Acceleration");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["Origin"]))
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(0), x(d["sum_Acceleration"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(0) - x(d["sum_Acceleration"])))
      .attr("y", marginTop)
      .attr("height", Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom) - marginTop);

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {

  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"count": rows.length}), d => d["weather"], d => new Date(2012, d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"weather": k1, "month_date": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);

    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["month_date"], d["weather"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"month_date": __c, "weather": __g, "count": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["month_date"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["weather"], b["weather"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["count"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["count"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "count_stack0": y0, "count_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["month_date"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["count_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["count_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["weather"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["weather"]))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["count_stack1"]), y(d["count_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["count_stack0"]) - y(d["count_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["month_date"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth());

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);

    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["weather"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["weather"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"count": rows.length}), d => d["weather"], d => new Date(2012, d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"weather": k1, "month_date": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["month_date"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["weather"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["month_date"], d["weather"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"month_date": __c, "weather": __g, "count": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["month_date"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["weather"], b["weather"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["count"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["count"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "count_stack0": y0, "count_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["month_date"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["count_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["count_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["weather"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["weather"]))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["count_stack1"]), y(d["count_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["count_stack0"]) - y(d["count_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["month_date"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth());

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.year == 2000);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "gender": (d.sex == 2 ? 'Female' : 'Male')}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => JSON.stringify([d["age"]])), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["people"]);
      let acc = 0;
      return rows.map(d => {
        const y0 = acc;
        acc += +d["people"];
        const y1 = acc;
        return {...d, "v1": total ? y0 / total : 0, "v2": total ? y1 / total : 0};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["age"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["v1"]), data1.map(d => d["v2"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["gender"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), ["#675193", "#ca8861"]); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("age");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("population");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["gender"]))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["v1"]), y(d["v2"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["v2"]) - y(d["v1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["age"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth());

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])

      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")

      .attr("x", d => x(d["month_date"]))

      .attr("opacity", d => 0.5);

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/population.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["people"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["people"]));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.year == 2000);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "gender": (d.sex == 2 ? 'Female' : 'Male')}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_people": d3.sum(rows, d => d["people"])}), d => d["age"], d => d["people"]), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"age": k1, "people": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["age"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["people"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["age"], d["people"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"age": __c, "people": __g, "sum_people": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["age"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["people"], b["people"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["sum_people"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["sum_people"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "sum_people_stack0": y0, "sum_people_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["age"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["sum_people_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["sum_people_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const opacity = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["people"]), [0.1, 1]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("age");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("population");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["sum_people_stack1"]), y(d["sum_people_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["sum_people_stack0"]) - y(d["sum_people_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["age"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth())
      .attr("opacity", d => opacity(d["people"]));

  return svg.node();
}


===== stacked_bar_weather.vl.json [EXEC] =====

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/seattle-weather.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"count": rows.length}), d => d["weather"], d => new Date(2012, d["date"].getMonth(), 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"weather": k1, "month_date": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["month_date"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["weather"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["month_date"], d["weather"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"month_date": __c, "weather": __g, "count": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["month_date"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["weather"], b["weather"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["count"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["count"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "count_stack0": y0, "count_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["month_date"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["count_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["count_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(["sun", "fog", "drizzle", "rain", "snow"], ["#e7ba52", "#c7c7c7", "#aec7e8", "#1f77b4", "#9467bd"]); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Month of the year");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["weather"]))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["count_stack1"]), y(d["count_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["count_stack0"]) - y(d["count_stack1"])))
      .attr("x", d => x(d["month_date"]))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth());

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 50;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 5;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 15;

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_Horsepower": d3.mean(rows, d => d["Horsepower"])}), d => d["Origin"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"Origin": k1, ...vals}));

  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Origin");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("fill", "black")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(data1)
    .join("text")
      .attr("x", d => width / 2)
      .attr("y", d => y(d["Origin"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("dy", "0.32em")
      .text(d => d["mean_Horsepower"]);

  return svg.node();
}

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Cylinders");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("stroke", "black")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(data1)
    .join("line")
      .attr("y1", d => y(d["Cylinders"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 - y.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("y2", d => y(d["Cylinders"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2 + y.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("x1", d => x(d["Horsepower"]))
      .attr("x2", d => x(d["Horsepower"]));

  return svg.node();
}

import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d.symbol==='GOOG');
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"sum_price": d3.sum(rows, d => d["price"])}), d => new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)), ([k1, vals]) => ({"year_date": k1, ...vals}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["year_date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["sum_price"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("stroke", "black")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(data1)
    .join("line")
      .attr("y1", d => y(d["sum_price"]) - 4)
      .attr("y2", d => y(d["sum_price"]) + 4)
      .attr("x1", d => x(d["year_date"]))
      .attr("x2", d => x(d["year_date"]));

  return svg.node();

import * as d3 from "d3";
// NOTE: this file depends on vl2d3-runtime.js (a copy of vl2d3's own src/runtime.js) --
// it is not a fully standalone snippet; keep that file alongside this one.
import {vlTrailPath} from "./vl2d3-runtime.js";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/stocks.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));

  const x = d3.scaleTime(d3.extent(data1, d => d["date"]), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["price"]), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["symbol"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();
  const size = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent(data1, d => d["price"]), [1, 4]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["symbol"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("fill", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([key, rows]) => (() => { const ctx = d3.path(); vlTrailPath(ctx, rows.filter(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"])).slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["date"], b["date"])).map(d => ({x: x(d["date"]), y: y(d["price"]), w: size(d["price"])}))); return ctx.toString(); })());

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

async function chart_facetTemplate(container, options = {}, __facetRows, __facetXDomain, __facetYDomain) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = __facetRows;
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["X"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["X"]) && d["Y"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Y"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(__facetXDomain, [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(__facetYDomain, [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("X");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Y");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["X"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["Y"]))
      .attr("r", d => 3)
      .attr("opacity", d => 1);

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  // vl2d3: unsupported top-level composition "facet", splitting the shared data by facet value at runtime instead of code-generation time -- each panel shows a plain text header (the raw/timeUnit'd facet value), not Vega-Lite's own fully templated header (--ignore-unsupported)
  let facetData = await d3.json(new URL("data/anscombe.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  const __facetXDomain = d3.extent(facetData, d => d["X"]);
  const __facetYDomain = d3.extent(facetData, d => d["Y"]);
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "__facetKey": d["Series"]}));
  const __facetGroups = Array.from(d3.group(facetData, d => d["__facetKey"]), ([key, rows]) => ({key, rows}));
  __facetGroups.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.key, b.key));
  const doc = container.ownerDocument;
  const wrap = doc.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 4px;";
  container.appendChild(wrap);
  for (const {key, rows} of __facetGroups) {
    const panelWrap = doc.createElement("div");
    wrap.appendChild(panelWrap);
    const label = doc.createElement("div");
    label.style.cssText = "font-size: 11px; font-family: sans-serif;";
    label.textContent = String(key);
    panelWrap.appendChild(label);
    const panel = doc.createElement("div");
    panelWrap.appendChild(panel);
    await chart_facetTemplate(panel, options, rows, __facetXDomain, __facetYDomain);
  }
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

async function chart_facetTemplate(container, options = {}, __facetRows, __facetColorDomain, __facetXDomain, __facetYDomain) {
  const width = options.width ?? 300;
  const height = options.height ?? 40;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 12;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 16;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = __facetRows;
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = (() => {
    const __cats = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["date"])));
    const __groups = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["symbol"])));
    const __present = new Set(data1.map(d => JSON.stringify([d["date"], d["symbol"]])));
    const __filled = [];
    for (const __c of __cats) for (const __g of __groups) if (!__present.has(JSON.stringify([__c, __g]))) __filled.push({"date": __c, "symbol": __g, "price": 0});
    return [...data1, ...__filled];
  })();
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["date"]), ([, rows]) => {
      rows = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["symbol"], b["symbol"]));
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["price"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["price"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "price_stack0": y0, "price_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleTime(__facetXDomain, [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(__facetYDomain, [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]);
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(__facetColorDomain, d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Time");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Price");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.7)
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(d3.group(data1, d => d["symbol"]))
    .join("path")
      .attr("fill", ([key]) => color(key))
      .attr("d", ([, rows]) => d3.area().defined(d => d["date"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["date"]) && d["price_stack1"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price_stack1"]) && d["price_stack0"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price_stack0"])).x(d => x(d["date"])).y0(d => y(d["price_stack0"])).y1(d => y(d["price_stack1"]))(rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a["date"], b["date"]))));

  return svg.node();
}

  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "__facetKey": d["symbol"]}));

  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = __facetRows;
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]));
  const data1_Horsepower_bins = d3.bin().value(d => d["Horsepower"]).thresholds(15)(data1);
  data1 = data1_Horsepower_bins.map(bin => ({"bin0_Horsepower": bin.x0, "bin1_Horsepower": bin.x1, "count": bin.length}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["bin0_Horsepower"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["count"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["count"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "count_stack0": y0, "count_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(__facetXDomain, [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["count_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["count_stack1"]))), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).nice();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d["bin0_Horsepower"]), x(d["bin1_Horsepower"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d["bin1_Horsepower"]) - x(d["bin0_Horsepower"])))
      .attr("y", d => Math.min(y(d["count_stack1"]), y(d["count_stack0"])))
      .attr("height", d => Math.abs(y(d["count_stack0"]) - y(d["count_stack1"])));

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  // vl2d3: unsupported top-level composition "facet", splitting the shared data by facet value at runtime instead of code-generation time -- each panel shows a plain text header (the raw/timeUnit'd facet value), not Vega-Lite's own fully templated header (--ignore-unsupported)
  let facetData = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  const __facetXDomain = d3.extent(facetData, d => d["Horsepower"]);
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "__facetKey": d["Origin"]}));
  const __facetGroups = Array.from(d3.group(facetData, d => d["__facetKey"]), ([key, rows]) => ({key, rows}));
  __facetGroups.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.key, b.key));
  const doc = container.ownerDocument;
  const wrap = doc.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;";
  container.appendChild(wrap);
  for (const {key, rows} of __facetGroups) {
    const panelWrap = doc.createElement("div");
    wrap.appendChild(panelWrap);
    const label = doc.createElement("div");
    label.style.cssText = "font-size: 11px; font-family: sans-serif;";
    label.textContent = String(key);
    panelWrap.appendChild(label);
    const panel = doc.createElement("div");
    panelWrap.appendChild(panel);
    await chart_facetTemplate(panel, options, rows, __facetXDomain);
  }
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

async function chart_facetTemplate(container, options = {}, __facetRows, __facetColorDomain, __facetXDomain) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = __facetRows;
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["yield"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["yield"]));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"median_yield": d3.median(rows, d => d["yield"])}), d => d["variety"], d => d["year"]), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"variety": k1, "year": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(__facetXDomain, [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["variety"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(__facetColorDomain, d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("yield");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("variety");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["year"]))
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["median_yield"]))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["variety"]) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  // vl2d3: unsupported top-level composition "facet", splitting the shared data by facet value at runtime instead of code-generation time -- each panel shows a plain text header (the raw/timeUnit'd facet value), not Vega-Lite's own fully templated header (--ignore-unsupported)
  let facetData = await d3.json(new URL("data/barley.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  const __facetColorDomain = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(facetData.map(d => d["year"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b));
  const __facetXDomain = d3.extent(Array.from(d3.rollup(facetData, rows => d3.median(rows, d => d["yield"]), d => (d["site"]), d => d["variety"], d => d["year"]), ([, byCat]) => Array.from(byCat, ([, byGroup]) => d3.sum(byGroup.values()))).flat());
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "__facetKey": d["site"]}));
  const __facetGroups = Array.from(d3.group(facetData, d => d["__facetKey"]), ([key, rows]) => ({key, rows}));
  __facetGroups.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.rows[0]["yield"], b.rows[0]["yield"]));
  const doc = container.ownerDocument;
  const wrap = doc.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, auto); gap: 4px;";
  container.appendChild(wrap);
  for (const {key, rows} of __facetGroups) {
    const panelWrap = doc.createElement("div");
    wrap.appendChild(panelWrap);
    const label = doc.createElement("div");
    label.style.cssText = "font-size: 11px; font-family: sans-serif;";
    label.textContent = String(key);
    panelWrap.appendChild(label);
    const panel = doc.createElement("div");
    panelWrap.appendChild(panel);
    const __panelHeight = 12 * new d3.InternSet(rows.map(d => d["variety"])).size;
    await chart_facetTemplate(panel, {...options, height: __panelHeight, ...(__panelHeight < 50 ? {marginTop: Math.max(1, Math.round(__panelHeight * 0.3)), marginBottom: Math.max(1, Math.round(__panelHeight * 0.4))} : {})}, rows, __facetColorDomain, __facetXDomain);
  }
}

// Generated by vl2d3.vegaLiteToD3Code(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: false, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as d3 from "d3";

async function chart_facetTemplate(container, options = {}, __facetRows, __facetColorDomain, __facetYDomain) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = __facetRows;
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["price"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["price"]));
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_price": d3.mean(rows, d => d["price"])}), d => d["symbol"], d => new Date(2012, Math.floor(d["date"].getMonth() / 3) * 3, 1)), ([k1, __inner0]) => Array.from(__inner0, ([k2, vals]) => ({"symbol": k1, "quarter_date": k2, ...vals}))).flat(1);

  const x = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["quarter_date"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).padding(0.1);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(__facetYDomain, [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]);
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(__facetColorDomain, d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("date");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("price");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data1)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => color(d["symbol"]))
      .attr("cx", d => x(d["quarter_date"]) + x.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("cy", d => y(d["mean_price"]))
      .attr("r", d => 3);

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  // vl2d3: unsupported top-level composition "facet", splitting the shared data by facet value at runtime instead of code-generation time -- each panel shows a plain text header (the raw/timeUnit'd facet value), not Vega-Lite's own fully templated header (--ignore-unsupported)

  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "date": new Date(d["date"])}));
  const __facetColorDomain = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(facetData.map(d => d["symbol"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b));
  const __facetYDomain = d3.extent(Array.from(d3.rollup(facetData, rows => d3.mean(rows, d => d["price"]), d => (new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)), d => d["date"], d => d["symbol"]), ([, byCat]) => Array.from(byCat, ([, byGroup]) => d3.sum(byGroup.values()))).flat());
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "__facetKey": new Date(d["date"].getFullYear(), 0, 1)}));
  const __facetGroups = Array.from(d3.group(facetData, d => d["__facetKey"]), ([key, rows]) => ({key, rows}));
  __facetGroups.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.key, b.key));
  const doc = container.ownerDocument;
  const wrap = doc.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 4px;";
  container.appendChild(wrap);
  for (const {key, rows} of __facetGroups) {
    const panelWrap = doc.createElement("div");
    wrap.appendChild(panelWrap);

    const panel = doc.createElement("div");

import * as d3 from "d3";

async function chart_facetTemplate(container, options = {}, __facetRows, __facetColorDomain, __facetShapeDomain, __facetXDomain, __facetYDomain) {
  const width = options.width ?? 640;
  const height = options.height ?? 400;
  const marginTop = options.marginTop ?? 20;
  const marginRight = options.marginRight ?? 20;
  const marginBottom = options.marginBottom ?? 30;
  const marginLeft = options.marginLeft ?? 50;

  let data1 = __facetRows;
  data1 = data1.filter(d => d["Horsepower"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Horsepower"]) && d["Miles_per_Gallon"] != null && !Number.isNaN(d["Miles_per_Gallon"]));

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(__facetXDomain, [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear(__facetYDomain, [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]);
  const color = (() => { const __scale = d3.scaleOrdinal(__facetColorDomain, d3.schemeTableau10); return Object.assign(v => (v == null ? "none" : __scale(v)), __scale); })();
  const shape = d3.scaleOrdinal(__facetShapeDomain, [d3.symbolCircle, d3.symbolSquare, d3.symbolCross, d3.symbolDiamond, d3.symbolTriangle, d3.symbolTriangle2, d3.symbolStar, d3.symbolWye]);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Horsepower");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("Miles_per_Gallon");

  {
    const pointSymbol = d3.symbol().type(d => shape(d["Origin"])).size(d => Math.PI * Math.pow(3, 2));
    svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .selectAll("path")
      .data(data1)
      .join("path")
        .attr("fill", d => color(d["Cylinders"]))
        .attr("transform", d => "translate(" + (x(d["Horsepower"])) + "," + (y(d["Miles_per_Gallon"])) + ")")
        .attr("d", pointSymbol)
  }

  {
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - marginRight - 100},${marginTop})`);
    const entries = color.domain();
    const rows = legend.selectAll("g").data(entries).join("g")
        .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0,${i * 16})`);
    rows.append("rect").attr("width", 10).attr("height", 10).attr("fill", d => color(d));
    rows.append("text").attr("x", 14).attr("y", 9).attr("font-size", "10px").text(d => d);
  }

  return svg.node();
}

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  // vl2d3: unsupported top-level composition "facet", splitting the shared data by facet value at runtime instead of code-generation time -- each panel shows a plain text header (the raw/timeUnit'd facet value), not Vega-Lite's own fully templated header (--ignore-unsupported)
  let facetData = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  const __facetColorDomain = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(facetData.map(d => d["Cylinders"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b));
  const __facetShapeDomain = Array.from(new d3.InternSet(facetData.map(d => d["Origin"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b));
  const __facetXDomain = d3.extent(facetData, d => d["Horsepower"]);
  const __facetYDomain = d3.extent(facetData, d => d["Miles_per_Gallon"]);
  facetData = facetData.map(d => ({...d, "__facetRowKey": d["Cylinders"], "__facetColKey": d["Origin"]}));
  const __facetRowValues = Array.from(new Set(facetData.map(d => d["__facetRowKey"])));
  const __facetColValues = Array.from(new Set(facetData.map(d => d["__facetColKey"])));
  __facetRowValues.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b));
  __facetColValues.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b));
  const doc = container.ownerDocument;
  const grid = doc.createElement("div");
  grid.style.cssText = "display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto repeat(" + __facetColValues.length + ", auto); gap: 4px; align-items: center;";
  container.appendChild(grid);
  grid.appendChild(doc.createElement("div"));
  for (const colKey of __facetColValues) {
    const colLabel = doc.createElement("div");
    colLabel.style.cssText = "font-size: 11px; font-family: sans-serif; text-align: center;";
    colLabel.textContent = String(colKey);
    grid.appendChild(colLabel);
  }
  for (const rowKey of __facetRowValues) {
    const rowLabel = doc.createElement("div");
    rowLabel.style.cssText = "font-size: 11px; font-family: sans-serif; writing-mode: vertical-rl; text-align: center;";
    rowLabel.textContent = String(rowKey);
    grid.appendChild(rowLabel);
    for (const colKey of __facetColValues) {
      const panel = doc.createElement("div");
      grid.appendChild(panel);
      const __cellRows = facetData.filter(d => d["__facetRowKey"] === rowKey && d["__facetColKey"] === colKey);
      if (__cellRows.length > 0) await chart_facetTemplate(panel, options, __cellRows, __facetColorDomain, __facetShapeDomain, __facetXDomain, __facetYDomain);
    }
  }
}

  let data1 = await d3.json(new URL("data/movies.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"Director": rows[0]["Director"], "aggregate_gross": d3.mean(rows, d => d["Worldwide Gross"])}), d => JSON.stringify([d["Director"]])).values());
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => 0).values()).flatMap(rows => {
  const cmp = (a, b) => (b["aggregate_gross"] > a["aggregate_gross"] ? 1 : b["aggregate_gross"] < a["aggregate_gross"] ? -1 : 0);
  rows = rows.slice().sort(cmp);
  const n = rows.length;
  return rows.map((d, i) => ({...d, "rank": i + 1}));
});
  data1 = data1.map(d => ({...d, "ranked_director": (d.rank < 10 ? d.Director : 'All Others')}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.rollup(data1, rows => ({"mean_aggregate_gross": d3.mean(rows, d => d["aggregate_gross"])}), d => d["ranked_director"]), ([k1, vals]) => ({"ranked_director": k1, ...vals}));
  data1 = Array.from(d3.group(data1, d => d["ranked_director"]), ([, rows]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(rows, d => d["mean_aggregate_gross"]);
      let acc = { pos: 0, neg: 0 };
      return rows.map(d => {
        const __v = +d["mean_aggregate_gross"];
      const y0 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
      if (__v >= 0) acc.pos += __v; else acc.neg += __v;
      const y1 = __v >= 0 ? acc.pos : acc.neg;
        return {...d, "mean_aggregate_gross_stack0": y0, "mean_aggregate_gross_stack1": y1};
      });
    }).flat();

  const x = d3.scaleLinear(d3.extent([].concat(data1.map(d => d["mean_aggregate_gross_stack0"]), data1.map(d => d["mean_aggregate_gross_stack1"]))), [marginLeft, Math.max(marginLeft, width - marginRight)]).nice();
  const y = d3.scaleBand(Array.from(new d3.InternSet(data1.map(d => d["ranked_director"]))).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b)), [Math.max(marginTop, height - marginBottom), marginTop]).padding(0.1);

  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width / 2)
      .attr("y", marginTop / 2)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("font-size", "14px")
      .attr("font-weight", "bold")
      .text("Top Directors by Average Worldwide Gross");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - marginRight)
      .attr("y", height - marginBottom - 6)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("aggregate_gross");

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", marginTop - 6)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .text("ranked_director");

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data1)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", d => Math.min(x(d["mean_aggregate_gross_stack1"]), x(d["mean_aggregate_gross_stack0"])))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d["mean_aggregate_gross_stack0"]) - x(d["mean_aggregate_gross_stack1"])))
      .attr("y", d => y(d["ranked_director"]))
      .attr("height", y.bandwidth());

  return svg.node();
}
